text: Behold, when it was whole, it was used for no work; how much less when the fire hath consumed it, and it is burned, should it yet be used for any work?

title: Ezekiel 15:6
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 15:7
text: And I will set my face against them: they shall go forth from [one] fire, and [another] fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah when I set my face against them.

title: Ezekiel 15:8
text: And I will make the land a desolation, because they have wrought unfaithfulness, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 16:2
text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

title: Ezekiel 16:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite: thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother a Hittite.

title: Ezekiel 16:4
text: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water for cleansing; thou wast not rubbed with salt at all, nor swaddled at all.

title: Ezekiel 16:5
text: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, from abhorrence of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

title: Ezekiel 16:6
text: ¶And I passed by thee, and saw thee weltering in thy blood, and I said unto thee, in thy blood, Live! yea, I said unto thee, in thy blood, Live!

title: Ezekiel 16:7
text: I caused thee to multiply, as the bud of the field; and thou didst increase and grow great, and thou camest to fulness of beauty; [thy] breasts were fashioned, and thy hair grew: but thou wast naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:8
text: And I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, and behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness; and I swore unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou becamest mine.

title: Ezekiel 16:9
text: And I washed thee with water, and thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil;

title: Ezekiel 16:10
text: and I clothed thee with embroidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I bound thee about with byssus, and covered thee with silk.

title: Ezekiel 16:11
text: And I decked thee with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck;

title: Ezekiel 16:12
text: and I put a ring on thy nose, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.

title: Ezekiel 16:13
text: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver, and thy raiment was byssus, and silk, and embroidered work. Thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou becamest exceedingly beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

title: Ezekiel 16:14
text: And thy fame went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect through my magnificence, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:15
text: ¶But thou didst confide in thy beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy whoredoms on every one that passed by: his it was.

title: Ezekiel 16:16
text: And of thy garments thou didst take, and madest for thyself high places decked with divers colours, and didst play the harlot thereupon: [the like] hath not come to pass, and shall be no more.

title: Ezekiel 16:17
text: And thou didst take thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of males, and didst commit fornication with them.

title: Ezekiel 16:18
text: And thou tookest thine embroidered garments, and coveredst them; and thou didst set mine oil and mine incense before them.

title: Ezekiel 16:19
text: And my bread which I had given thee, the fine flour and the oil and the honey wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savour: thus it was, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:20
text: And thou didst take thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hadst borne unto me, and these didst thou sacrifice unto them, to be devoured. Were thy whoredoms a small matter,

title: Ezekiel 16:21
text: that thou didst slay my children and give them up in passing them over to them?

title: Ezekiel 16:22
text: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, when thou wast weltering in thy blood.

title: Ezekiel 16:23
text: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord Jehovah),

title: Ezekiel 16:24
text: that thou didst also build unto thee a place of debauchery, and didst make thee a high place in every street:

title: Ezekiel 16:25
text: thou didst build thy high place at every head of the way, and madest thy beauty to be abhorred, and thou didst open thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiply thy whoredom.

title: Ezekiel 16:26
text: And thou didst commit fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and didst multiply thy whoredom to provoke me to anger.

title: Ezekiel 16:27
text: And behold, I stretched out my hand over thee, and diminished thine appointed portion; and I gave thee over unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, who were confounded at thy lewd way.

title: Ezekiel 16:28
text: And thou didst commit fornication with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou didst commit fornication with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

title: Ezekiel 16:29
text: And thou didst multiply thy whoredom with the land of merchants, Chaldea, and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

title: Ezekiel 16:30
text: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these [things], the work of a whorish woman, under no restraint;

title: Ezekiel 16:31
text: in that thou buildest thy place of debauchery at the head of every way, and makest thy high place in every street! And thou hast not been as a harlot, in that thou scornest reward,

title: Ezekiel 16:32
text: O adulterous wife, that taketh strangers instead of her husband.

title: Ezekiel 16:33
text: They give rewards to all harlots; but thou gavest thy rewards to all thy lovers, and rewardedst them, that they might come unto thee on every side for thy whoredoms.

title: Ezekiel 16:34
text: And in thee is the contrary from [other] women, in thy whoredoms, in that none followeth thee to commit fornication; and whereas thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, so art thou contrary.

title: Ezekiel 16:35
text: ¶Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:36
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy money hath been poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy fornications with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thine abominations, and because of the blood of thy children which thou didst give unto them;

title: Ezekiel 16:37
text: therefore, behold, I will gather all thy lovers with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all that thou hast loved, with all that thou hast hated, --I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

title: Ezekiel 16:38
text: And I will judge thee with the judgments of women that commit adultery and shed blood; and I will give thee up to the blood of fury and jealousy;

title: Ezekiel 16:39
text: and I will give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy place of debauchery, and shall break down thy high places; and they shall strip thee of thy garments, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:40
text: And they shall bring up an assemblage against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

title: Ezekiel 16:41
text: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from being a harlot, and thou also shalt give no more any reward.

title: Ezekiel 16:42
text: And I will appease my fury against thee, and my jealousy shall depart from thee; and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

title: Ezekiel 16:43
text: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast raged against me in all these [things], behold, therefore, I also will recompense thy way upon [thy] head, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou shalt not commit this lewdness besides all thine abominations.

title: Ezekiel 16:44
text: ¶Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall speak in a proverb against thee, saying, As the mother, [so is] her daughter!

title: Ezekiel 16:45
text: Thou art the daughter of thy mother that loathed her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

title: Ezekiel 16:46
text: And thine elder sister is Samaria that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

title: Ezekiel 16:47
text: And thou hast not walked in their ways, nor done according to their abominations; but as though that were a very little, thou hast been more corrupt than they in all thy ways.

title: Ezekiel 16:48
text: [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters!

title: Ezekiel 16:49
text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and careless ease was in her and in her daughters, but she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

title: Ezekiel 16:50
text: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me, and I took them away when I saw [it].

title: Ezekiel 16:51
text: And Samaria hath not sinned according to the half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.

title: Ezekiel 16:52
text: Thou also, who hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own confusion, because of thy sins in which thou hast acted more abominably than they: they are more righteous than thou. So be thou ashamed also, and bear thy confusion, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

title: Ezekiel 16:53
text: And I will bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;

title: Ezekiel 16:54
text: that thou mayest bear thy confusion, and mayest be confounded for all that thou hast done, in that thou comfortest them.

title: Ezekiel 16:55
text: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate; thou also and thy daughters, ye shall return to your former estate.

title: Ezekiel 16:56
text: Yea, Sodom thy sister was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

title: Ezekiel 16:57
text: before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise thee on every side.

title: Ezekiel 16:58
text: Thy lewdness and thine abominations, thou bearest them, saith Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:59
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath, and broken the covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:60
text: ¶Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:61
text: And thou shalt remember thy ways, and be confounded, when thou shalt receive thy sisters who are older than thou, together with those who are younger than thou; for I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by virtue of thy covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:62
text: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt know that I [am] Jehovah;

title: Ezekiel 16:63
text: that thou mayest remember, and be ashamed, and no more open thy mouth because of thy confusion, when I forgive thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 17:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:2
text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 17:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings, long-pinioned, full of feathers, which was of divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar.

title: Ezekiel 17:4
text: He cropped off the top of its young shoots, and carried it into a merchants' land; he set it in a city of traders.

title: Ezekiel 17:5
text: And he took of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, he set it as a willow tree.

title: Ezekiel 17:6
text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, so that its branches should turn toward him, and the roots thereof be under him; and it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

title: Ezekiel 17:7
text: And there was another great eagle with great wings and many feathers; and behold, from the beds of her plantation, this vine did bend her roots unto him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it.

title: Ezekiel 17:8
text: It was planted in a good field by many waters, that it might bring forth branches and bear fruit, that it might be a noble vine.

title: Ezekiel 17:9
text: Say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? Shall he not pull up its roots, and cut off its fruit, that it may wither? All its fresh sprouting leaves shall wither, even without a great arm and many people to pluck it up by its roots.

title: Ezekiel 17:10
text: And behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither when the east wind toucheth it? It shall wither in the beds where it grew.

title: Ezekiel 17:11
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:12
text: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things are? Say, Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king and its princes, and led them with him to Babylon.

title: Ezekiel 17:13
text: And he took of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and brought him under an oath, and he took away the mighty of the land;

title: Ezekiel 17:14
text: that the kingdom might be abased, that it might not lift itself up, that it might keep his covenant in order to stand.

title: Ezekiel 17:15
text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?

title: Ezekiel 17:16
text: [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, verily in the place of the king that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him, in the midst of Babylon, shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 17:17
text: Neither shall Pharaoh with a mighty army and a great assemblage do anything for him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

title: Ezekiel 17:18
text: He despised the oath, and broke the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, yet hath he done all these things: he shall not escape.

title: Ezekiel 17:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: [As] I live, verily, mine oath which he hath despised, and my covenant which he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his head.

title: Ezekiel 17:20
text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his unfaithfulness in which he hath been unfaithful against me.

title: Ezekiel 17:21
text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind; and ye shall know that I Jehovah have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 17:22
text: ¶Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also take of the highest branch of the lofty cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of its young shoots a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high and eminent mountain:

title: Ezekiel 17:23
text: upon the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth branches, and bear fruit, and become a noble cedar; and under it shall dwell all birds of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

title: Ezekiel 17:24
text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I Jehovah have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and made the dry tree to flourish: I Jehovah have spoken, and will do [it].

title: Ezekiel 18:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 18:2
text: What mean ye, ye who use this proverb of the land of Israel, saying, [The] fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?

title: Ezekiel 18:3
text: [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have any more to use this proverb in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 18:4
text: Behold, all the souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

title: Ezekiel 18:5
text: And if a man be righteous, and do judgment and justice:

title: Ezekiel 18:6
text: --he hath not eaten upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, nor come near to a woman in her separation,

title: Ezekiel 18:7
text: and hath not oppressed any; he hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath not exercised robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and covered the naked with a garment;

title: Ezekiel 18:8
text: he hath not given forth upon usury, nor taken increase; he hath withdrawn his hand from unrighteousness, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

title: Ezekiel 18:9
text: hath walked in my statutes, and kept mine ordinances, to deal faithfully: he is righteous, he shall certainly live, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 18:10
text: ¶And if he have begotten a son that is violent, a shedder of blood, and that doeth only one of any of these [things],

title: Ezekiel 18:11
text: and that doeth not any of those [duties], but also hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,

title: Ezekiel 18:12
text: hath oppressed the poor and needy, exercised robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, committed abomination,

title: Ezekiel 18:13
text: given forth upon usury, and taken increase; shall he then live? He shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall certainly die; his blood shall be upon him.

title: Ezekiel 18:14
text: But lo, if he have begotten a son that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like:

title: Ezekiel 18:15
text: --he hath not eaten upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,

title: Ezekiel 18:16
text: and hath not oppressed any, nor withholden the pledge, neither hath exercised robbery; he hath given his bread to the hungry, and covered the naked with a garment;

title: Ezekiel 18:17
text: he hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, [and] walked in my statutes: he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall certainly live.

title: Ezekiel 18:18
text: As for his father, because he practised oppression, exercised robbery upon his brother, and did what was not good among his people, behold, he shall die in his iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 18:19
text: And ye say, Why doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? But the son hath done judgment and justice, hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them; he shall certainly live.

title: Ezekiel 18:20
text: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

title: Ezekiel 18:21
text: ¶And the wicked, if he turn from all his sins which he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do judgment and justice, he shall certainly live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:22
text: None of his transgressions which he hath committed shall be remembered against him; in his righteousness which he hath done shall he live.

title: Ezekiel 18:23
text: Have I any pleasure at all in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; is it not in his turning from his way, that he may live?

title: Ezekiel 18:24
text: And when the righteous turneth from his righteousness and practiseth what is wrong, [and] doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous acts which he hath done shall be remembered: in his unfaithfulness which he hath wrought, and in his sin which he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 18:25
text: And ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear then, house of Israel. Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

title: Ezekiel 18:26
text: When the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and practiseth what is wrong, and dieth for it; in his wrong that he hath done shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 18:27
text: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness which he hath committed, and doeth judgment and justice, he shall keep his soul alive.

title: Ezekiel 18:28
text: Because he considereth, and turneth from all his transgressions which he hath committed, he shall certainly live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:29
text: But the house of Israel say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? Is it not your ways that are unequal?

title: Ezekiel 18:30
text: ¶Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord Jehovah. Return ye, and turn from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your snare.

title: Ezekiel 18:31
text: Cast away from you all your transgressions wherewith ye have transgressed, and make you a new heart and a new spirit: why then will ye die, house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 18:32
text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord Jehovah; therefore turn ye and live.

title: Ezekiel 19:1
text: ¶And thou, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 19:2
text: and say, What was thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps in the midst of the young lions.

title: Ezekiel 19:3
text: And she brought up one of her whelps; it became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

title: Ezekiel 19:4
text: And the nations heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with nose-rings into the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 19:5
text: And when she saw that she had waited [and] her hope was lost, she took another of her whelps, [and] made him a young lion.

title: Ezekiel 19:6
text: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

title: Ezekiel 19:7
text: And he knew their [desolate] palaces, and he laid waste their cities, so that the land was desolate, and all it contained, by the noise of his roaring.

title: Ezekiel 19:8
text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.

title: Ezekiel 19:9
text: And they put him in a cage with nose-rings, and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 19:10
text: ¶Thy mother was as a vine, in thy rest, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

title: Ezekiel 19:11
text: And it had strong rods for sceptres of them that bear rule, and its stature was exalted between the thick boughs; and it was conspicuous by its height with the multitude of its branches.

title: Ezekiel 19:12
text: But it was plucked up in fury, it was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit; its strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

title: Ezekiel 19:13
text: And now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground:

title: Ezekiel 19:14
text: and a fire is gone out of a rod of its branches, [which] hath devoured its fruit; so that it hath no strong rod to be a sceptre for ruling. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

title: Ezekiel 20:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth of the month, [that] certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Jehovah, and they sat before me.

title: Ezekiel 20:2
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:3
text: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Are ye come to inquire of me? [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

title: Ezekiel 20:4
text: Wilt thou judge them, wilt thou judge, son of man? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers,

title: Ezekiel 20:5
text: ¶and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up my hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand unto them, saying, I [am] Jehovah your God,

title: Ezekiel 20:6
text: in that day I lifted up my hand unto them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the ornament of all lands;

title: Ezekiel 20:7
text: and I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I [am] Jehovah your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:8
text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: none of them cast away the abominations of his eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I thought to pour out my fury upon them, so as to accomplish mine anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:9
text: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among whom they were, in whose sight I had made myself known unto them in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:10
text: ¶And I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:11
text: And I gave them my statutes, and made known unto them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them.

title: Ezekiel 20:12
text: And I also gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I [am] Jehovah that hallow them.

title: Ezekiel 20:13
text: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned: and I said I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

title: Ezekiel 20:14
text: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I had brought them out.

title: Ezekiel 20:15
text: And I also lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land that I had given [them], flowing with milk and honey, which is the ornament of all lands;

title: Ezekiel 20:16
text: because they rejected mine ordinances and walked not in my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:17
text: But mine eye spared them so as not to destroy them, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:18
text: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk not in the statutes of your fathers, neither keep their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:19
text: I [am] Jehovah your God: walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;

title: Ezekiel 20:20
text: and hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I [am] Jehovah your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:21
text: And the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept mine ordinances to do them, which if a man do, he shall live by them; they profaned my sabbaths: and I said I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish mine anger against them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:22
text: But I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I had brought them out.

title: Ezekiel 20:23
text: I lifted up my hand also unto them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations, and disperse them through the countries;

title: Ezekiel 20:24
text: because they performed not mine ordinances, and rejected my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:25
text: And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances whereby they should not live;

title: Ezekiel 20:26
text: and I defiled them by their own gifts, in that they devoted all that opened the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:27
text: ¶Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In this moreover have your fathers blasphemed me, in that they have wrought unfaithfulness against me.

title: Ezekiel 20:28
text: When I had brought them into the land which I had lifted up my hand to give unto them, then they saw every high hill and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering; and there they placed their sweet savour, and there poured out their drink-offerings.

title: Ezekiel 20:29
text: And I said unto them, What is the high place whither ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

title: Ezekiel 20:30
text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Do ye defile yourselves after the manner of your fathers? and do ye commit fornication after their abominations?

title: Ezekiel 20:31
text: And when ye offer your gifts, making your sons to pass through the fire, ye defile yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day; and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

title: Ezekiel 20:32
text: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, in serving wood and stone.

title: Ezekiel 20:33
text: ¶[As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, verily with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, will I reign over you.

title: Ezekiel 20:34
text: And I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out;

title: Ezekiel 20:35
text: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.

title: Ezekiel 20:36
text: Like as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:37
text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

title: Ezekiel 20:38
text: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me; I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:39
text: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Go ye, serve every one his idols henceforth also, if none of you will hearken unto me; but profane my holy name no more with your gifts and with your idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:40
text: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, there shall all the house of Israel serve me, the whole of it, in the land; there will I accept them, and there will I require your heave-offerings and the first-fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

title: Ezekiel 20:41
text: As a sweet savour will I accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be hallowed in you in the sight of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 20:42
text: And ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have brought you into the land of Israel, into the country which I lifted up my hand to give to your fathers.

title: Ezekiel 20:43
text: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils which ye have committed.

title: Ezekiel 20:44
text: And ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:45
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:46
text: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop [words] against the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

title: Ezekiel 20:47
text: and say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of Jehovah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flashing flame shall not be quenched; and all that it meets from the south to the north shall be burned thereby.

title: Ezekiel 20:48
text: And all flesh shall see that I Jehovah have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

title: Ezekiel 20:49
text: And I said, Ah, Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

title: Ezekiel 21:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against Jerusalem, and drop [words] against the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 21:3
text: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and I will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

title: Ezekiel 21:4
text: Seeing that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh, from the south to the north;

title: Ezekiel 21:5
text: and all flesh shall know that I Jehovah have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath: it shall not return any more.

title: Ezekiel 21:6
text: Sigh then, thou son of man; with breaking of the loins, and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 21:7
text: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore dost thou sigh? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall languish, and all knees shall melt into water: behold, it cometh; it is here, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:8
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:9
text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished.

title: Ezekiel 21:10
text: It is sharpened for sore slaughter, it is furbished that it may glitter. Shall we then make mirth, [saying,] The sceptre of my son contemneth all wood?

title: Ezekiel 21:11
text: And he hath given it to be furbished that it may be handled. The sword, --it is sharpened, and it is furbished to give it into the hand of the slayer.

title: Ezekiel 21:12
text: Cry and howl, son of man; for it shall be against my people, it shall be against all the princes of Israel: they are given up to the sword along with my people: smite therefore upon the thigh.

title: Ezekiel 21:13
text: For the trial [is made]; and what if even the contemning sceptre shall be no [more]? saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:14
text: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; for [the strokes of] the sword shall be doubled the third time: it is the sword of the slain, the sword that hath slain the great one, which encompasseth them privily.

title: Ezekiel 21:15
text: In order that the heart may melt, and the stumbling-blocks be multiplied, I have set the threatening sword against all their gates: ah! it is made glittering, it is whetted for the slaughter.

title: Ezekiel 21:16
text: Gather up [strength], go to the right hand, turn thee, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is appointed.

title: Ezekiel 21:17
text: And I myself will smite my hands together, and I will satisfy my fury: I Jehovah have spoken [it].

title: Ezekiel 21:18
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:19
text: And thou, son of man, set thee two ways, by which the sword of the king of Babylon may come--out of one land shall they both come--and make thee a signpost, make it at the head of the way to the city.

title: Ezekiel 21:20
text: Appoint a way for the coming of the sword to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah at the fenced [city] of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 21:21
text: For the king of Babylon standeth at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shaketh [his] arrows, he inquireth of the teraphim, he looketh in the liver.

title: Ezekiel 21:22
text: In his right hand is the lot of Jerusalem to appoint battering-rams, to open the mouth for bloodshed, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering-rams against the gates, to cast mounds, to build siege-towers.

title: Ezekiel 21:23
text: And this shall be a false divination in their sight, for them that have sworn oaths; but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

title: Ezekiel 21:24
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye make your iniquity to be remembered in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

title: Ezekiel 21:25
text: And thou, profane, wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, at the time of the iniquity of the end,

title: Ezekiel 21:26
text: --thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre and take off the crown; what is shall be no [more]. Exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.

title: Ezekiel 21:27
text: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it! This also shall be no [more], until he come whose right it is; and I will give it [to him].

title: Ezekiel 21:28
text: ¶And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus speaketh the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and thou shalt say, A sword, a sword is drawn; for the slaughter is it furbished, that it may consume, that it may glitter:

title: Ezekiel 21:29
text: whilst they see vanity for thee, whilst they divine a lie unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are slain, whose day is come at the time of the iniquity of the end.

title: Ezekiel 21:30
text: Restore [it] to its sheath. I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth.

title: Ezekiel 21:31
text: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow upon thee the fire of my wrath, and give thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.

title: Ezekiel 21:32
text: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt not be remembered: for I Jehovah have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 22:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:2
text: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? Yea, cause her to know all her abominations,

title: Ezekiel 22:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in her midst, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

title: Ezekiel 22:4
text: Thou art become guilty by thy blood which thou hast shed, and hast defiled thyself with thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking unto all countries.

title: Ezekiel 22:5
text: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, who art infamous [and] full of tumult.

title: Ezekiel 22:6
text: Behold, the princes of Israel have been in thee to shed blood, each according to his power.

title: Ezekiel 22:7
text: In thee have they made light of father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger; in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

title: Ezekiel 22:8
text: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 22:9
text: In thee there have been slanderous men to shed blood; and in thee have they eaten upon the mountains; in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness;

title: Ezekiel 22:10
text: in thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her separation.

title: Ezekiel 22:11
text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

title: Ezekiel 22:12
text: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast overreached thy neighbours by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 22:13
text: And behold, I have smitten mine hand at thine overreaching which thou hast done, and at thy bloodshed which hath been in the midst of thee.

title: Ezekiel 22:14
text: Shall thy heart endure, shall thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I Jehovah have spoken, and will do [it].

title: Ezekiel 22:15
text: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

title: Ezekiel 22:16
text: And thou shalt be polluted through thyself in the sight of the nations, and thou shalt know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 22:17
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:18
text: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross to me: they are all copper, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace: they are become the dross of silver.

title: Ezekiel 22:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 22:20
text: [As] they gather silver, and copper, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it, so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will lay you on and melt you.

title: Ezekiel 22:21
text: Yea, I will collect you, and blow upon you the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 22:22
text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I Jehovah have poured out my fury upon you.

title: Ezekiel 22:23
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:24
text: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

title: Ezekiel 22:25
text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst of her like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they devour souls; they take away treasure and precious things; they increase her widows in the midst of her;

title: Ezekiel 22:26
text: her priests do violence to my law, and profane my holy things: they put no difference between the holy and profane, neither do they make known [the difference] between the unclean and the clean, and they hide their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

title: Ezekiel 22:27
text: Her princes in the midst of her are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

title: Ezekiel 22:28
text: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered [mortar], seeing vanity and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah! and Jehovah hath not spoken.

title: Ezekiel 22:29
text: The people of the land use oppression and practise robbery; and they vex the poor and needy, and oppress the stranger wrongfully.

title: Ezekiel 22:30
text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the fence, and stand in the breach before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.

title: Ezekiel 22:31
text: And I will pour out mine indignation upon them; I will consume them in the fire of my wrath: their own way will I recompense upon their head, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 23:2
text: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.

title: Ezekiel 23:3
text: And they committed whoredom in Egypt; they committed whoredom in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there were handled the teats of their virginity.

title: Ezekiel 23:4
text: And their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister; and they were mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

title: Ezekiel 23:5
text: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she lusted after her lovers, after the Assyrians [her] neighbours,

title: Ezekiel 23:6
text: clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them attractive young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:7
text: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, all of them the choice of the children of Asshur; and with all after whom she lusted, with all their idols she defiled herself.

title: Ezekiel 23:8
text: Neither left she her whoredoms [brought] from Egypt; for in her youth they had lain with her, and had handled the breasts of her virginity, and poured their fornication upon her.

title: Ezekiel 23:9
text: Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the children of Asshur, after whom she lusted.

title: Ezekiel 23:10
text: These discovered her nakedness, they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword; and she became a name among women; and they executed judgment upon her.

title: Ezekiel 23:11
text: ¶And her sister Oholibah saw [this], and was more corrupt in her passion than she, and in her fornications more than the whoredoms of her sister.

title: Ezekiel 23:12
text: She lusted after the children of Asshur [her] neighbours, governors and rulers, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them attractive young men.

title: Ezekiel 23:13
text: And I saw that she was defiled: both took one way.

title: Ezekiel 23:14
text: And she increased her fornications; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

title: Ezekiel 23:15
text: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them captains in appearance, [after] the likeness of the children of Babylon, of Chaldea, the land of their nativity.

title: Ezekiel 23:16
text: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she lusted after them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

title: Ezekiel 23:17
text: And the children of Babylon came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their fornication; she too defiled herself with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

title: Ezekiel 23:18
text: And she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness; and my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.

title: Ezekiel 23:19
text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she played the harlot in the land of Egypt;

title: Ezekiel 23:20
text: and she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh is [as] the flesh of asses, and whose issue is [as] the issue of horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:21
text: And thou didst look back to the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy teats by the Egyptians, for the breasts of thy youth.

title: Ezekiel 23:22
text: ¶Therefore, Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side.

title: Ezekiel 23:23
text: The children of Babylon, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the children of Asshur with them; all of them attractive young men, governors and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:24
text: And they shall come against thee [with] armour, chariots and wheels, and with an assemblage of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee [with] target, and shield, and helmet round about; and I will put judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

title: Ezekiel 23:25
text: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall cut off thy nose and thine ears, and thy remnant shall fall by the sword; they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:26
text: They shall also strip the of thy garments, and take away thy fair jewels.

title: Ezekiel 23:27
text: And I will make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom [brought] from the land of Egypt; and thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

title: Ezekiel 23:28
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give thee over into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated.

title: Ezekiel 23:29
text: And they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare; so that the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy fornications.

title: Ezekiel 23:30
text: These things shall be done unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the nations, because thou hast defiled thyself with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 23:31
text: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; and I have given her cup into thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 23:32
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large; thou shalt be for a laughing-stock and a derision, [for] it containeth much.

title: Ezekiel 23:33
text: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, the cup of thy sister Samaria;

title: Ezekiel 23:34
text: thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:35
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy fornications.

title: Ezekiel 23:36
text: ¶And Jehovah said unto me, Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations.

title: Ezekiel 23:37
text: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also passed over unto them their children, whom they bore unto me, to be devoured.

title: Ezekiel 23:38
text: Moreover this have they done unto me: in the same day have they defiled my sanctuary and profaned my sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 23:39
text: For when they had slaughtered their children unto their idols, they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

title: Ezekiel 23:40
text: And furthermore, they sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thine eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments;

title: Ezekiel 23:41
text: and satest upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hadst set mine incense and mine oil.

title: Ezekiel 23:42
text: And the voice of a multitude living carelessly was with her; and with people of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, and they put bracelets upon their hands, and a beautiful crown upon their heads.

title: Ezekiel 23:43
text: And I said of her that was old in adulteries, Will she now commit her fornications, even she.

title: Ezekiel 23:44
text: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a whorish woman: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah the lewd women.

title: Ezekiel 23:45
text: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; for they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

title: Ezekiel 23:46
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up an assemblage against them, and will give them to be driven hither and thither and spoiled.

title: Ezekiel 23:47
text: And the assemblage shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:48
text: And I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, and all women shall receive instruction and shall not do according to your lewdness.

title: Ezekiel 23:49
text: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:1
text: ¶And in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:2
text: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, of this selfsame day: on this selfsame day the king of Babylon draws near to Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 24:3
text: And propose a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Set on the pot, set [it] on, and also pour water into it.

title: Ezekiel 24:4
text: Gather the pieces thereof into it, every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder; fill [it] with the choice bones:

title: Ezekiel 24:5
text: take the choice of the flock; and also [put] a pile of wood under it, for the bones; make it boil well, and let the bones of it seethe therein.

title: Ezekiel 24:6
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! Bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it:

title: Ezekiel 24:7
text: for her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.

title: Ezekiel 24:8
text: That it might cause fury to come up to execute vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.

title: Ezekiel 24:9
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

title: Ezekiel 24:10
text: Heap on the wood, kindle the fire, boil thoroughly the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

title: Ezekiel 24:11
text: Then set it empty upon its coals, that it may be hot, and the brass of it may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, [and] that its rust may be consumed.

title: Ezekiel 24:12
text: She hath exhausted [her] labours, yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her: let her rust be in the fire.

title: Ezekiel 24:13
text: In thy filthiness is lewdness, for I have purged thee, and thou art not pure. Thou shalt no more be purged from thy filthiness, till I have satisfied my fury upon thee.

title: Ezekiel 24:14
text: I Jehovah have spoken [it]: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, nor will I repent. According to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:15
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:16
text: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke; yet thou shalt not mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

title: Ezekiel 24:17
text: Sigh in silence, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy turban upon thee, and put thy sandals upon thy feet, and cover not the beard, and eat not the bread of men.

title: Ezekiel 24:18
text: --And I spoke unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died. And I did in the morning as I was commanded.

title: Ezekiel 24:19
text: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, which thou doest?

title: Ezekiel 24:20
text: And I said to them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:21
text: Say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and your soul's longing; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 24:22
text: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover the beard, neither eat the bread of men;

title: Ezekiel 24:23
text: and your turbans shall be upon your heads, and your sandals upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall waste away in your iniquities and moan one toward another.

title: Ezekiel 24:24
text: Thus Ezekiel shall be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when it cometh, then ye shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:25
text: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereunto they lift up their soul, their sons and their daughters,

title: Ezekiel 24:26
text: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause [thine] ears to hear [it]?

title: Ezekiel 24:27
text: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb. So shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 25:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them;

title: Ezekiel 25:3
text: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:

title: Ezekiel 25:4
text: therefore behold, I will give thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruits, and they shall drink thy milk.

title: Ezekiel 25:5
text: And I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:6
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped the hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 25:7
text: therefore behold, I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and will give thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee, and thou shalt know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:8
text: ¶Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations,

title: Ezekiel 25:9
text: therefore behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities even to the last of them, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kirjathaim,

title: Ezekiel 25:10
text: unto the children of the east, with [the land of] the children of Ammon; and I will give it them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations:

title: Ezekiel 25:11
text: and I will execute judgments upon Moab, and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:12
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath made himself very guilty, and revenged himself upon them,

title: Ezekiel 25:13
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom; and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 25:14
text: And I will execute my vengeance upon Edom, by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:15
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul, to destroy, from old hatred;

title: Ezekiel 25:16
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I stretch out my hands upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites, and cause the remnant of the sea-coast to perish.

title: Ezekiel 25:17
text: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

title: Ezekiel 26:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, [that] the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 26:2
text: Son of man, because Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken, the gate of the peoples! she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished [now] she is laid waste;

title: Ezekiel 26:3
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

title: Ezekiel 26:4
text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. And I will scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

title: Ezekiel 26:5
text: She shall be [a place] for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil for the nations.

title: Ezekiel 26:6
text: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 26:7
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring from the north, against Tyre, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, the king of kings, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and an assemblage, and much people.

title: Ezekiel 26:8
text: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field, and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and lift up the target against thee;

title: Ezekiel 26:9
text: and he shall set his engines of attack against thy walls, and with his spikes he shall break down thy towers.

title: Ezekiel 26:10
text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee; thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter through thy gates, as a city is entered into, wherein is made a breach.

title: Ezekiel 26:11
text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people by the sword, and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 26:12
text: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy wares; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.

title: Ezekiel 26:13
text: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

title: Ezekiel 26:14
text: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be [a place] for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 26:15
text: ¶Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

title: Ezekiel 26:16
text: And all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling, they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble [every] moment, and be astonied because of thee.

title: Ezekiel 26:17
text: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How hast thou perished, that wast inhabited from the seas, O renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, --she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all them that dwell therein!

title: Ezekiel 26:18
text: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; and the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

title: Ezekiel 26:19
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters cover thee:

title: Ezekiel 26:20
text: then will I bring thee down, with them that go down to the pit, to the people of old time, and will cause thee to dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 26:21
text: And I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no [more]; and thou shalt be sought for, and shalt never be found again, for ever, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 27:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying:

title: Ezekiel 27:2
text: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre,

title: Ezekiel 27:3
text: and say unto Tyre: O thou that art situate at the entries of the sea, and traffickest with the peoples in many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:4
text: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:5
text: They made all thy double boards of cypress-trees of Senir; they took cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:6
text: Of the oaks of Bashan did they make thine oars; they made thy benches of ivory, inlaid in box-wood, out of the isles of Chittim.

title: Ezekiel 27:7
text: Byssus with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, to serve thee for a banner; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.

title: Ezekiel 27:8
text: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy rowers; thy wise men, O Tyre, who were in thee, were thy pilots.

title: Ezekiel 27:9
text: The elders of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee repairing thy leaks; all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee, to barter with thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:10
text: Persia and Lud and Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged shield and helmet in thee; they gave splendour to thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:11
text: The children of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadim were on thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they made thy beauty perfect.

title: Ezekiel 27:12
text: Tarshish dealt with thee by reason of the abundance of all substance; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they furnished thy markets.

title: Ezekiel 27:13
text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers: they bartered with thee the persons of men, and vessels of bronze.

title: Ezekiel 27:14
text: They of the house of Togarmah furnished thy markets with horses, and horsemen, and mules.

title: Ezekiel 27:15
text: The children of Dedan were thy traffickers; many isles were the mart of thy hand: they rendered in payment horns of ivory, and ebony.

title: Ezekiel 27:16
text: Syria dealt with thee for the multitude of thy handiworks: they traded in thy markets with carbuncles, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and corals, and rubies.

title: Ezekiel 27:17
text: Judah and the land of Israel were thy traffickers: they bartered with thee wheat of Minnith, and sweet cakes, and honey, and oil, and balm.

title: Ezekiel 27:18
text: Damascus dealt with thee because of the multitude of thy handiworks, by reason of the abundance of all substance, with wine of Helbon, and white wool.

title: Ezekiel 27:19
text: Vedan and Javan of Uzal traded in thy markets: wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were in thy traffic.

title: Ezekiel 27:20
text: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious riding-cloths.

title: Ezekiel 27:21
text: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were the merchants of thy hand: in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these did they trade with thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:22
text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah were thy traffickers: they furnished thy markets with all the choice spices, and with all precious stones and gold.

title: Ezekiel 27:23
text: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with thee:

title: Ezekiel 27:24
text: these traded with thee in sumptuous clothes, in wrappings of blue and broidered work, and in chests full of variegated stuffs, bound with cords and made of cedar-wood, amongst thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:25
text: The ships of Tarshish were thy caravans for thy traffic; and thou wast replenished, and highly honoured, in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:26
text: ¶Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters; the east wind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:27
text: Thy substance, and thy markets, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, they that repair thy leaks, and they that barter with thee, and all thy men of war that are in thee, along with all thine assemblage which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy fall.

title: Ezekiel 27:28
text: The open places shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

title: Ezekiel 27:29
text: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land,

title: Ezekiel 27:30
text: and shall cause their voice to be heard over thee, and shall cry bitterly; and they shall cast up dust upon their heads; they shall wallow themselves in ashes.

title: Ezekiel 27:31
text: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird themselves with sackcloth; and they shall weep for thee in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.

title: Ezekiel 27:32
text: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, [saying,] Who is like Tyre, like her that is destroyed in the midst of the sea?

title: Ezekiel 27:33
text: When thy wares went forth over the seas, thou filledst many peoples; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the abundance of thy substance and of thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:34
text: In the time [when] thou art broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, thy merchandise and all thine assemblage in the midst of thee have fallen.

title: Ezekiel 27:35
text: All the inhabitants of the isles are amazed at thee, and their kings are horribly afraid, [their] countenance is troubled.

title: Ezekiel 27:36
text: The merchants among the peoples hiss at thee; thou art become a terror, and thou shalt never be any more.

title: Ezekiel 28:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:2
text: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a *god, I sit [in] the seat of God, in the heart of the seas, (and thou art a man, and not *God,) and thou settest thy heart as the heart of God:

title: Ezekiel 28:3
text: behold, thou art wiser than Daniel! nothing secret is obscure for thee;

title: Ezekiel 28:4
text: by thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures;

title: Ezekiel 28:5
text: by thy great wisdom thou hast by thy traffic increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches.

title: Ezekiel 28:6
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God,

title: Ezekiel 28:7
text: therefore behold, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall tarnish thy brightness.

title: Ezekiel 28:8
text: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of those that are slain in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 28:9
text: Wilt thou then say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and not *God, in the hand of him that pierceth thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:10
text: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised, by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:11
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:12
text: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, who sealest up the measure of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty,

title: Ezekiel 28:13
text: thou wast in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone was thy covering: the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the chrysolite, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the carbuncle, and the emerald, and gold. The workmanship of thy tambours and of thy pipes was in thee: in the day that thou wast created were they prepared.

title: Ezekiel 28:14
text: Thou wast the anointed covering cherub, and I had set thee [so]: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou didst walk up and down in the midst of stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:15
text: Thou wast perfect in thy ways, from the day that thou wast created, till unrighteousness was found in thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:16
text: By the abundance of thy traffic they filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned; therefore have I cast thee as profane from the mountain of God, and have destroyed thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:17
text: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty; thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I have cast thee to the ground, I have laid thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:18
text: By the multitude of thine iniquities, by the unrighteousness of thy traffic, thou hast profaned thy sanctuaries: and I have brought forth a fire out of the midst of thee--it hath consumed thee; and I have brought thee to ashes upon the earth, in the sight of all them that behold thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:19
text: All they that know thee among the peoples shall be amazed at thee: thou art become a terror, and thou shalt never be any more.

title: Ezekiel 28:20
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:21
text: Son of man, set thy face towards Zidon, and prophesy against it,

title: Ezekiel 28:22
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Zidon, and I will be glorified in the midst of thee; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be hallowed in her.

title: Ezekiel 28:23
text: And I will send into her the pestilence, and blood in her streets; and the wounded shall fall in the midst of her, by the sword upon her on every side: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:24
text: And there shall be no more a wounding sting for the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn, among all that were round about them, that despised them: and they shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:25
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be hallowed in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their land which I have given to my servant Jacob.

title: Ezekiel 28:26
text: They shall dwell in it in safety, and shall build houses and plant vineyards; and they shall dwell in safety, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despised them round about them: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah their God.

title: Ezekiel 29:1
text: ¶In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], on the twelfth of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against the whole of Egypt;

title: Ezekiel 29:3
text: speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which saith, My river is mine own, and I made it for myself.

title: Ezekiel 29:4
text: And I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales;

title: Ezekiel 29:5
text: and I will cast thee into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open field; thou shalt not be brought together nor gathered: I will give thee for meat to the beasts of the earth and to the fowl of the heavens.

title: Ezekiel 29:6
text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I [am] Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 29:7
text: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst give way and rend all their shoulder; and when they leaned upon thee, thou didst break, and didst make all their loins to tremble.

title: Ezekiel 29:8
text: ¶Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast from thee.

title: Ezekiel 29:9
text: And the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, because he saith, The river is mine, and I made it.

title: Ezekiel 29:10
text: Therefore behold, I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt deserts of wasteness and desolation, from Migdol to Syene, even unto the border of Ethiopia.

title: Ezekiel 29:11
text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor shall foot of beast pass through it, nor shall it be inhabited, forty years.

title: Ezekiel 29:12
text: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of the countries that are desolated, and her cities shall be, in the midst of the cities that are laid waste, a desolation forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 29:13
text: Yet thus saith the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples whither they were scattered;

title: Ezekiel 29:14
