text: and I will turn again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return to the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth, and they shall there be a base kingdom.

title: Ezekiel 29:15
text: It shall be the basest of kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations; and I will diminish them, so that they shall no more rule over the nations.

title: Ezekiel 29:16
text: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they turn after them: and they shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:17
text: ¶And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first [month], on the first of the month, [that] the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:18
text: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to do hard service against Tyre; every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he from Tyre no wages, nor his army, for the service that he had served against it.

title: Ezekiel 29:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry away her multitude, and seize her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

title: Ezekiel 29:20
text: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:21
text: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:2
text: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Howl ye, Alas for the day!

title: Ezekiel 30:3
text: For the day is at hand, yea, the day of Jehovah is at hand, a day of clouds; it shall be the time of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 30:4
text: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and there shall be anguish in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be overthrown.

title: Ezekiel 30:5
text: Cush, and Phut, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her strength shall come down: from Migdol to Syene shall they fall in her by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:7
text: And they shall be desolated in the midst of the countries that are desolated, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

title: Ezekiel 30:8
text: And they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers shall be broken.

title: Ezekiel 30:9
text: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships, to make careless Ethiopia afraid; and anguish shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for behold, it cometh!

title: Ezekiel 30:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

title: Ezekiel 30:11
text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with slain.

title: Ezekiel 30:12
text: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I Jehovah have spoken [it].

title: Ezekiel 30:13
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince out of the land of Egypt; and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:14
text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgment in No.

title: Ezekiel 30:15
text: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

title: Ezekiel 30:16
text: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be rent asunder, and at Noph [there shall be] enemies in open day.

title: Ezekiel 30:17
text: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and these shall go into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 30:18
text: And at Tehaphnehes the day shall be darkened, when I break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her strength shall cease in her; as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 30:19
text: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:20
text: ¶And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [month], on the seventh of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:21
text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and behold, it shall not be bound up to apply remedies, to put a bandage to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:22
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong one, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

title: Ezekiel 30:23
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 30:24
text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; and I will break Pharaoh's arms, so that he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly-wounded [man].

title: Ezekiel 30:25
text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall have stretched it out upon the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:26
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 31:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third [month], on the first of the month, [that] the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 31:2
text: Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

title: Ezekiel 31:3
text: Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with fair branches and a shadowing shroud, and of a high stature: and his top was amidst the thick boughs.

title: Ezekiel 31:4
text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high; its streams ran round about his plantation, and it sent out its rivulets unto all the trees of the field.

title: Ezekiel 31:5
text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long, because of great waters, when he shot forth.

title: Ezekiel 31:6
text: All the fowl of the heavens made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all the great nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:7
text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: because his root was by great waters.

title: Ezekiel 31:8
text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him; the cypresses were not like his boughs, and the plane-trees were not as his branches: no tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

title: Ezekiel 31:9
text: I had made him fair by the multitude of his branches; and all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

title: Ezekiel 31:10
text: ¶Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast lifted up thyself in stature, ...and he hath set his top amidst the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

title: Ezekiel 31:11
text: I have given him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

title: Ezekiel 31:12
text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off and have left him; upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken in all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

title: Ezekiel 31:13
text: Upon his fallen [trunk] do all the fowl of the heavens dwell, and all the beasts of the field are upon his branches:

title: Ezekiel 31:14
text: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, nor set their top amidst the thick boughs, and that none of them that drink water stand up in his height by himself; for they are all given over unto death in the lower parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 31:15
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed; and I made Lebanon black for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

title: Ezekiel 31:16
text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol, with them that go down into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

title: Ezekiel 31:17
text: They also went down into Sheol with him unto them that were slain with the sword, and [that were] his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:18
text: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden, unto the lower parts of the earth; thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:2
text: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou wast like a young lion among the nations, and thou wast as a monster in the seas; and thou didst break forth in thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

title: Ezekiel 32:3
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also spread out my net over thee with an assemblage of many peoples; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

title: Ezekiel 32:4
text: And I will leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowl of the heavens to settle upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:5
text: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with the heap of thy [members];

title: Ezekiel 32:6
text: and I will water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the water-courses shall be full of thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:7
text: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heavens, and make the stars thereof black; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

title: Ezekiel 32:8
text: All the bright lights of the heavens will I make black over thee, and bring darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:9
text: And I will vex the heart of many peoples, when I bring [the news of] thy destruction among the nations, into the countries that thou hast not known.

title: Ezekiel 32:10
text: And I will make many peoples amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid at thee, when I brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, each one for his life, in the day of thy fall.

title: Ezekiel 32:11
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:12
text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall: the terrible of the nations are they all: and they shall spoil the pride of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

title: Ezekiel 32:13
text: And I will destroy all the beasts thereof, from beside the great waters; and the foot of man shall not trouble them any more, nor shall the cloven hoofs of beasts trouble them.

title: Ezekiel 32:14
text: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:15
text: When I shall make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the country shall be left desolate of all that was in it, when I have smitten all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:16
text: It is a lamentation, and [thus] they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall say it in lamenting; they shall say it in lamenting over Egypt and over all her multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:17
text: ¶And it came to pass in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:18
text: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, her and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the lower parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:19
text: Whom dost thou surpass in beauty? Go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

title: Ezekiel 32:20
text: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword. The sword hath been given: draw her out, and all her multitudes.

title: Ezekiel 32:21
text: The strong among the mighty, with them that helped him, shall speak to him out of the midst of Sheol: they are gone down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:22
text: There is Asshur and all his assemblage, his graves round about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword;

title: Ezekiel 32:23
text: their graves are set in the sides of the pit, and his assemblage is round about his grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, --who caused terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:24
text: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised unto the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their confusion with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:25
text: They have set him a bed in the midst of the slain, with all his multitude: their graves are round about him, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though their terror was caused in the land of the living; and they have borne their confusion with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that are slain.

title: Ezekiel 32:26
text: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude, their graves round about them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:27
text: And they lie not with the mighty, [that are] fallen of the uncircumcised, who are gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war; and whose swords are laid under their heads, and whose iniquities are upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:28
text: Thou also shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:29
text: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with them that are slain by the sword: they lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:30
text: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, that are gone down with the slain--ashamed of the terror which they caused through their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their confusion with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:31
text: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:32
text: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 33:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:2
text: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among them all, and set him for their watchman:

title: Ezekiel 33:3
text: if he see the sword coming upon the land, and blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

title: Ezekiel 33:4
text: then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning, if the sword come and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

title: Ezekiel 33:5
text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood is upon him: whereas had he taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:6
text: But if the watchman see the sword coming, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned, if the sword come and take a person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:7
text: So thou, son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; and thou shalt hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

title: Ezekiel 33:8
text: When I say unto the wicked, Wicked [man], thou shalt certainly die; and thou speakest not to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked [man] shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:9
text: But if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:10
text: ¶And thou, son of man, say unto the house of Israel, Thus ye speak, saying, Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we waste away in them, how then should we live?

title: Ezekiel 33:11
text: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 33:12
text: And thou, son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live thereby in the day that he sinneth.

title: Ezekiel 33:13
text: When I say to the righteous that he shall certainly live, and he trusteth to his righteousness and doeth what is wrong, none of his righteous acts shall be remembered; but in his unrighteousness which he hath done, in it shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 33:14
text: And when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt certainly die, and he turneth from his sin, and doeth judgment and justice;

title: Ezekiel 33:15
text: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, doing nothing that is wrong; he shall certainly live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 33:16
text: None of his sins which he hath committed shall be remembered against him: he hath done judgment and justice; he shall certainly live.

title: Ezekiel 33:17
text: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

title: Ezekiel 33:18
text: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and doeth what is wrong, then he shall die therein.

title: Ezekiel 33:19
text: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth judgment and justice, he shall live for these things.

title: Ezekiel 33:20
text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

title: Ezekiel 33:21
text: ¶And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth [month], on the fifth of the month, that one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten!

title: Ezekiel 33:22
text: Now the hand of Jehovah had been upon me in the evening, before he that had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth against his coming to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

title: Ezekiel 33:23
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:24
text: Son of man, they that inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited this land, and we are many: the land is given us for a possession.

title: Ezekiel 33:25
text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood; and shall ye possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:26
text: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife; and shall ye possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:27
text: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: [As] I live, verily they that are in the waste places shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

title: Ezekiel 33:28
text: And I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment, and the pride of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolated, so that none shall pass through.

title: Ezekiel 33:29
text: And they shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.

title: Ezekiel 33:30
text: ¶And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people keep talking of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 33:31
text: And they come unto thee as a people cometh, and they sit before thee [as] my people, and they hear thy words, but they do them not; for with their mouth they shew much love, [but] their heart goeth after their dishonest gain.

title: Ezekiel 33:32
text: And behold, thou art unto them as a lovely song, a pleasant voice, and one that playeth well on an instrument; and they hear thy words, but they do them not.

title: Ezekiel 33:33
text: And when this cometh to pass (behold, it will come), then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

title: Ezekiel 34:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 34:2
text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy; and say unto them, unto the shepherds, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the shepherds of Israel that feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed the flock?

title: Ezekiel 34:3
text: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool; ye kill them that are fattened: [but] ye feed not the flock.

title: Ezekiel 34:4
text: The weak have ye not strengthened, nor have ye healed the sick, and ye have not bound up [what was] broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought for that which was lost; but with harshness and with rigour have ye ruled over them.

title: Ezekiel 34:5
text: And they were scattered because there was no shepherd; and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.

title: Ezekiel 34:6
text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill, and my sheep have been scattered upon all the face of the earth, and there was none that searched, or that sought for them.

title: Ezekiel 34:7
text: ¶Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 34:8
text: [As] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, verily because my sheep have been a prey, and my sheep have been meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds searched not for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock,

title: Ezekiel 34:9
text: --therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock: that the shepherds may feed themselves no more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

title: Ezekiel 34:11
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold I, [even] I, will both search for my sheep, and tend them.

title: Ezekiel 34:12
text: As a shepherd tendeth his flock in the day that he is among his scattered sheep, so will I tend my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

title: Ezekiel 34:13
text: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the water-courses, and in all the habitable places of the country.

title: Ezekiel 34:14
text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold, and in a fat pasture they shall feed upon the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 34:15
text: I will myself feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:16
text: I will seek the lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up the broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong: I will feed them with judgment.

title: Ezekiel 34:17
text: ¶And as for you, my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, between the rams and the he-goats.

title: Ezekiel 34:18
text: Is it too small a thing unto you to have eaten up the good pastures, but ye must tread down with your feet the rest of your pastures; and to have drunk of the settled waters, but ye must foul the rest with your feet?

title: Ezekiel 34:19
text: And my sheep have to eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and to drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

title: Ezekiel 34:20
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto them: Behold, [it is] I, and I will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

title: Ezekiel 34:21
text: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the weak ones with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad,

title: Ezekiel 34:22
text: --I will save my flock, that they may no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.

title: Ezekiel 34:23
text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David: he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

title: Ezekiel 34:24
text: And I Jehovah will be their God, and my servant David a prince in their midst: I Jehovah have spoken [it].

title: Ezekiel 34:25
text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell in safety in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

title: Ezekiel 34:26
text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season: there shall be showers of blessing.

title: Ezekiel 34:27
text: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase; and they shall be in safety in their land, and shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have broken the bands of their yoke and delivered them out of the hand of those that kept them in servitude.

title: Ezekiel 34:28
text: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beast of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell in safety, and none shall make them afraid.

title: Ezekiel 34:29
text: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the ignominy of the nations any more.

title: Ezekiel 34:30
text: And they shall know that I Jehovah their God [am] with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:31
text: And ye, my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men: I [am] your God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 35:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

title: Ezekiel 35:3
text: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.

title: Ezekiel 35:4
text: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be a desolation: and thou shalt know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:5
text: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword, in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;

title: Ezekiel 35:6
text: therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will certainly appoint thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee; since thou hast not hated blood, blood shall pursue thee.

title: Ezekiel 35:7
text: And I will make mount Seir a desolation and an astonishment, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth;

title: Ezekiel 35:8
text: and I will fill his mountains with his slain. In thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy water-courses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

title: Ezekiel 35:9
text: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not be inhabited: and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:10
text: ¶Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it, whereas Jehovah was there:

title: Ezekiel 35:11
text: therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will even do according to thine anger and according to thine envy, as thou hast done out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.

title: Ezekiel 35:12
text: And thou shalt know that I Jehovah have heard all thy reproaches, which thou hast uttered against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.

title: Ezekiel 35:13
text: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard [them].

title: Ezekiel 35:14
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee a desolation.

title: Ezekiel 35:15
text: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolated, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be a desolation, O mount Seir, and all Edom, the whole of it: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:1
text: ¶And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:2
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are become ours in possession;

title: Ezekiel 36:3
text: therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because, yea, because they have made [you] desolate, and have swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the remnant of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and in the defaming of the people:

title: Ezekiel 36:4
text: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the water-courses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and a derision to the remnant of the nations that are round about,

title: Ezekiel 36:5
text: --therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the remnant of the nations, and against the whole of Edom, which have appointed my land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all [their] heart, with despite of soul, to plunder it by pillage.

title: Ezekiel 36:6
text: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the water-courses and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the ignominy of the nations;

title: Ezekiel 36:7
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have lifted up my hand, [saying,] Verily the nations that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

title: Ezekiel 36:8
text: And ye mountains of Israel shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel: for they are at hand to come.

title: Ezekiel 36:9
text: For behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown.

title: Ezekiel 36:10
text: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, the whole of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.

title: Ezekiel 36:11
text: And I will multiply upon you man and beast, and they shall increase and bring forth fruit; and I will cause you to be inhabited as [in] your former times, yea, I will make it better than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:12
text: And I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.

title: Ezekiel 36:13
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because they say unto you, Thou devourest men, and hast bereaved thy nation,

title: Ezekiel 36:14
text: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nation any more, saith the Lord Jehovah;

title: Ezekiel 36:15
text: neither will I cause thee to hear the ignominy of the nations any more, and thou shalt not bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to fall any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:16
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 36:17
text: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a woman in her separation.

title: Ezekiel 36:18
text: And I poured out my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 36:19
text: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

title: Ezekiel 36:20
text: And when they came to the nations whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when it was said of them, These are the people of Jehovah, and they are gone forth out of his land.

title: Ezekiel 36:21
text: But I had pity for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations whither they went.

title: Ezekiel 36:22
text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations whither ye went.

title: Ezekiel 36:23
text: And I will hallow my great name, which was profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I [am] Jehovah, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be hallowed in you before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 36:24
text: And I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

title: Ezekiel 36:25
text: ¶And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols will I cleanse you.

title: Ezekiel 36:26
text: And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

title: Ezekiel 36:27
text: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes and keep mine ordinances, and ye shall do them.

title: Ezekiel 36:28
text: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers, and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

title: Ezekiel 36:29
text: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses; and I will call for the corn and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.

title: Ezekiel 36:30
text: And I will multiply the fruit of the trees and the increase of the field, so that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

title: Ezekiel 36:31
text: And ye shall remember your evil ways, and your doings which were not good, and shall loathe yourselves for your iniquities and for your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 36:32
text: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord Jehovah, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 36:33
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I shall cleanse you from all your iniquities I will also cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.

title: Ezekiel 36:34
text: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all that passed by.

title: Ezekiel 36:35
text: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities [are] fortified [and] inhabited.

title: Ezekiel 36:36
text: And the nations that shall be left round about you shall know that I Jehovah build the ruined places [and] plant that which was desolate: I Jehovah have spoken, and I will do [it].

title: Ezekiel 36:37
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will yet for this be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it unto them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

title: Ezekiel 36:38
text: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her set feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:1
text: ¶The hand of Jehovah was upon me, and Jehovah carried me out in the Spirit, and set me down in the midst of a valley; and it was full of bones.

title: Ezekiel 37:2
text: And he caused me to pass by them round about; and behold, there were very many in the open valley; and behold, they were very dry.

title: Ezekiel 37:3
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, Shall these bones live? And I said, Lord Jehovah, thou knowest.

title: Ezekiel 37:4
text: And he said unto me, Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them, Ye dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:5
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.

title: Ezekiel 37:6
text: And I will put sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live: and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:7
text: And I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a rustling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

title: Ezekiel 37:8
text: And I looked, and behold, sinews and flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them over; but there was no breath in them.

title: Ezekiel 37:9
text: And he said unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

title: Ezekiel 37:10
text: And I prophesied as he had commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

title: Ezekiel 37:11
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off!

title: Ezekiel 37:12
text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, O my people, and bring you into the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 37:13
text: And ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah, when I have opened your graves, and have caused you to come up out of your graves, O my people.

title: Ezekiel 37:14
text: And I will put my Spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I will place you in your own land: and ye shall know that I Jehovah have spoken, and have done [it], saith Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:15
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 37:16
text: And thou, son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel, his companions. And take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim and all the house of Israel, his companions.

title: Ezekiel 37:17
text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:18
text: And when the children of my people speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not declare unto us what thou meanest by these?

title: Ezekiel 37:19
text: say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions, and will put them with this, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:20
text: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 37:21
text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, whither they are gone, and will gather them from every side, and bring them into their own land:

title: Ezekiel 37:22
text: and I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

title: Ezekiel 37:23
text: And they shall not defile themselves any more with their idols, or with their detestable things, or with any of their transgressions; and I will save them out of all their dwelling-places wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them; and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

title: Ezekiel 37:24
text: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: and they shall walk in mine ordinances, and keep my statutes, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 37:25
text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and David my servant shall be their prince for ever.

title: Ezekiel 37:26
text: And I will make a covenant of peace with them: it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for ever.

title: Ezekiel 37:27
text: And my tabernacle shall be over them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

title: Ezekiel 37:28
text: And the nations shall know that I Jehovah do hallow Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for ever.

title: Ezekiel 38:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 38:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

title: Ezekiel 38:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

title: Ezekiel 38:4
text: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them thoroughly equipped, a great assemblage with targets and shields, all of them handling swords:

title: Ezekiel 38:5
text: Persia, Cush, and Phut with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

title: Ezekiel 38:6
text: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah from the uttermost north, and all his bands; --many peoples with thee.

title: Ezekiel 38:7
text: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself thou, and all thine assemblage that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

title: Ezekiel 38:8
text: After many days shalt thou be visited; at the end of years thou shalt come into the land brought back from the sword [and] gathered out of many peoples, upon the mountains of Israel which have been a perpetual waste: but it is brought forth out from the peoples, and they shall all of them be dwelling in safety.

title: Ezekiel 38:9
text: And thou shalt ascend, thou shalt come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many peoples with thee.

title: Ezekiel 38:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: It shall even come to pass in that day that things shall come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought;

title: Ezekiel 38:11
text: and thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will come to them that are in quiet, that dwell in safety, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

title: Ezekiel 38:12
text: to seize a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thy hand against the waste places that are [now] inhabited, and against a people gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the middle of the land.

title: Ezekiel 38:13
text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to seize a spoil? hast thou gathered thine assemblage to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take cattle and goods, to seize a great spoil?

title: Ezekiel 38:14
text: ¶Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In that day when my people Israel dwelleth in safety, shalt thou not know [it]?

title: Ezekiel 38:15
text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the uttermost north, thou and many peoples with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great assemblage and a mighty army.

title: Ezekiel 38:16
text: And thou shalt come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land--it shall be at the end of days--and I will bring thee against my land, that the nations may know me, when I shall be hallowed in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 38:17
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Art thou not he of whom I have spoken in old time through my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days, for [many] years, that I would bring thee against them?

title: Ezekiel 38:18
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, in the day when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, [that] my fury shall come up in my face;

title: Ezekiel 38:19
text: for in my jealousy, in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Verily in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 38:20
text: so that the fish of the sea, and the fowl of the heavens, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things which creep upon the earth, and all mankind that are upon the face of the earth shall shake at my presence; and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 38:21
text: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord Jehovah: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

title: Ezekiel 38:22
text: And I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many peoples that are with him, overflowing rain and great hailstones, fire and brimstone.

title: Ezekiel 38:23
text: And I will magnify myself, and sanctify myself, and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:1
text: ¶And thou, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal;

title: Ezekiel 39:2
text: and I will turn thee back, and lead thee, and will cause thee to come up from the uttermost north, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 39:3
text: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

title: Ezekiel 39:4
text: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the peoples that are with thee: I have given thee to be meat for the birds of prey of every wing, and to the beasts of the field.

title: Ezekiel 39:5
text: Thou shalt fall on the open field; for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:6
text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell at ease in the isles: and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:7
text: And my holy name will I make known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not suffer my holy name to be profaned any more: and the nations shall know that I [am] Jehovah, the Holy One in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 39:8
text: ¶Behold, it cometh, and shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah. This is the day whereof I have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 39:9
text: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall kindle fire, and burn weapons, and shields, and targets, bows, and arrows, and hand-staves, and spears: and they shall make fires with them seven years.

title: Ezekiel 39:10
text: And no wood shall be taken out of the field, neither cut down out of the forests; for they shall make fire with the weapons; and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and plunder those that plundered them, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:11
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] I will give unto Gog a place there for burial in Israel, the valley of the passers-by to the east of the sea; and it shall stop [the way] of the passers-by; and there shall they bury Gog and all the multitude; and they shall call it, Valley of Hamon-Gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:12
text: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying them, that they may cleanse the land;

title: Ezekiel 39:13
text: and all the people of the land shall bury [them]; and it shall be to them for renown in the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:14
text: And they shall sever out men of continual employment to go through the land, who, with the passers-by, shall bury those that remain upon the face of the land, to cleanse it: at the end of seven months shall they make a search.

title: Ezekiel 39:15
text: And the passers-by shall pass through the land, and when [any] seeth a man's bone, he shall set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-Gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:16
text: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

title: Ezekiel 39:17
text: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Speak unto the birds of every wing, and to every beast of the field, Gather yourselves together and come, assemble yourselves on every side to my sacrifice which I sacrifice for you, a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

title: Ezekiel 39:18
text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, [and] of bullocks, all of them fatted beasts of Bashan.

title: Ezekiel 39:19
text: And ye shall eat fat till ye are full, and drink blood till ye are drunken, of my sacrifice which I sacrifice for you.

title: Ezekiel 39:20
text: And ye shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:21
text: And I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see my judgment which I have executed, and my hand which I have laid upon them.

title: Ezekiel 39:22
text: And the house of Israel shall know that I [am] Jehovah their God from that day and forward.

title: Ezekiel 39:23
text: ¶And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they were unfaithful against me; and I hid my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies, so that they fell all of them by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 39:24
text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions I did unto them, and I hid my face from them.

title: Ezekiel 39:25
text: Therefore, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name:

title: Ezekiel 39:26
text: and they shall bear their confusion, and all their unfaithfulness in which they have acted unfaithfully against me, when they shall dwell safely in their land, and none shall make them afraid;

title: Ezekiel 39:27
text: when I have brought them again from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am hallowed in them in the sight of many nations.

title: Ezekiel 39:28
text: And they shall know that I [am] Jehovah their God, in that I caused them to be led into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

title: Ezekiel 39:29
text: And I will not hide my face any more from them, for I shall have poured out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 40:1
text: ¶In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, on that same day the hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me thither.

title: Ezekiel 40:2
text: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain; and upon it was as the building of a city, on the south.

title: Ezekiel 40:3
text: And he brought me thither, and behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a flax-cord in his hand, and a measuring-reed; and he stood in the gate.

title: Ezekiel 40:4
text: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thy heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for in order that it might be shewn unto thee art thou brought hither. Declare to the house of Israel all that thou seest.

title: Ezekiel 40:5
text: ¶And behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring-reed of six cubits, [each] of one cubit and a hand breadth. And he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:6
text: And he came to the gate which looked toward the east, and went up its steps; and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold one reed broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:7
text: And [each] chamber was one reed long and one reed broad; and between the chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate, beside the porch of the gate within, was one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:8
text: And he measured the porch of the gate within, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:9
text: And he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

title: Ezekiel 40:10
text: And the chambers of the gate which was toward the east were three on this side and three on that side: they three were of one measure; and the posts on this side and on that side had one measure.

title: Ezekiel 40:11
text: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; [and] the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:12
text: And there was a border before the chambers of one cubit, and a border of one cubit on the other side; and the chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

title: Ezekiel 40:13
text: And he measured the gate from the roof of [one] chamber to the roof [of the other], a breadth of five and twenty cubits, entry opposite entry.

title: Ezekiel 40:14
text: And he made posts, sixty cubits, and by the post was the court of the gate round about.

title: Ezekiel 40:15
text: And from the front of the gate of the entrance unto the front of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:16
text: And there were closed windows to the chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the projections; and the windows round about were inward; and upon [each] post were palm-trees.

title: Ezekiel 40:17
text: And he brought me into the outer court, and behold, there were cells, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty cells were upon the pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:18
text: And the pavement was by the side of the gates, answering to the length of the gates, [namely] the lower pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:19
text: And he measured the breadth from the front of the lower gate unto the front of the inner court outside, a hundred cubits eastward and northward.

title: Ezekiel 40:20
text: And the gate of the outer court, that looked toward the north, he measured its length and its breadth.

title: Ezekiel 40:21
text: And its chambers were three on this side and three on that side; and its posts and its projections were according to the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and breadth five and twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:22
text: And its windows, and its projections, and its palm-trees were according to the measure of the gate that looked toward the east; and they went up to it by seven steps; and the projections thereof were before them.

title: Ezekiel 40:23
text: And the gate of the inner court was opposite to the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:24
text: And he brought me toward the south: and behold, there was a gate toward the south; and he measured its posts and its projections according to these measures.

title: Ezekiel 40:25
text: And there were windows to it and to its projections round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:26
text: And there were seven steps to go up to it; and its projections were before them; and it had palm-trees, one on this side and one on that side, upon its posts.

title: Ezekiel 40:27
text: ¶And there was a gate to the inner court toward the south; and he measured from gate to gate toward the south, a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:28
text: And he brought me into the inner court by the south gate; and he measured the south gate according to these measures:

title: Ezekiel 40:29
text: and its chambers, and its posts, and its projections, according to these measures; and there were windows to it and to its projections round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:30
text: And there were projections round about, twenty-five cubits long, and five cubits broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:31
text: And its projections were toward the outer court; and there were palm-trees upon its posts: and its ascent was [by] eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:32
text: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east; and he measured the gate according to these measures:

title: Ezekiel 40:33
text: and its chambers, and its posts, and its projections, according to these measures; and there were windows to it and to its projections round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:34
text: And its projections were toward the outer court; and there were palm-trees upon its posts on this side and on that side: and its ascent was [by] eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:35
text: And he brought me to the north gate, and he measured [it] according to these measures:

title: Ezekiel 40:36
text: its chambers, its posts, and its projections; and there were windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:37
text: And its posts were toward the outer court; and there were palm-trees upon its posts, on this side and on that side: and its ascent was [by] eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:38
text: And there was a cell and its entry by the posts of the gates; there they rinsed the burnt-offering.

title: Ezekiel 40:39
text: ¶And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt-offering and the sin-offering and the trespass-offering.

title: Ezekiel 40:40
text: And at the side without, at the ascent to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables:

title: Ezekiel 40:41
text: four tables on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate, --eight tables, whereon they slew [the sacrifice],

title: Ezekiel 40:42
text: --and at the ascent, four tables of hewn stone, of a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high; whereon also they laid the instruments with which they slew the burnt-offering and the sacrifice.

title: Ezekiel 40:43
text: And the double hooks of a hand breadth were fastened round about within; and upon the tables [they put] the flesh of the offering.

title: Ezekiel 40:44
text: And outside the inner gate were two cells in the inner court, one at the side of the north gate, and its front towards the south; the other was at the side of the south gate, the front towards the north.

title: Ezekiel 40:45
text: And he said unto me, This cell whose front is towards the south is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

title: Ezekiel 40:46
text: And the cell whose front is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, those who, from among the sons of Levi, approach unto Jehovah to minister unto him.

title: Ezekiel 40:47
text: And he measured the court, the length a hundred cubits, and the breadth a hundred cubits, four square: and the altar was before the house.

title: Ezekiel 40:48
text: And he brought me to the porch of the house; and he measured the post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and the breadth of the gate, three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

title: Ezekiel 40:49
text: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits, even by the steps whereby they went up to it; and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and one on that side.

title: Ezekiel 41:1
text: ¶And he brought me to the temple; and he measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, the breadth of the tent.

title: Ezekiel 41:2
text: And the breadth of the entry was ten cubits, and the sides of the entry were five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:3
text: And he went inwards, and measured the post of the entry, two cubits; and the entry, six cubits; and the breadth of the entry, seven cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:4
text: And he measured its length, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy [place].

title: Ezekiel 41:5
text: And he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of the side-chambers, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

title: Ezekiel 41:6
text: And the side-chambers were three, chamber over chamber, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which the house had for the side-chambers round about, that they might have hold; but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

title: Ezekiel 41:7
text: And for the side-chambers there was an enlarging, and it went round about [the house] increasing upward; for the surrounding of the house increased upward round about the house; therefore the house had width upward, and so ascended [from] the lower [story] to the upper, by the middle one.

title: Ezekiel 41:8
text: And I saw that the house had an elevation round about: the foundations of the side-chambers, a full reed, six cubits to the joint.

title: Ezekiel 41:9
text: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side-chambers without, was five cubits, as also what was left free along the building of the side-chambers that pertained to the house.

title: Ezekiel 41:10
text: And between the cells [and the house] was a width of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

title: Ezekiel 41:11
text: And the entry of the side-chambers was toward what was left free, one entry toward the north, and one entry toward the south; and the width of the space left free was five cubits round about.

title: Ezekiel 41:12
text: ¶And the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about; and its length ninety cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:13
text: And he measured the house: the length a hundred cubits; and the separate place, and the building, and its walls, the length a hundred cubits;

title: Ezekiel 41:14
text: and the breadth of the front of the house, and of the separate places toward the east, a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:15
text: And he measured the length of the building before the separate place, which was at the back of it, with its galleries on the one side and on the other side, a hundred cubits; and the inner temple, and the porches of the court.

title: Ezekiel 41:16
text: The thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries round about the three of them (opposite the thresholds it was wainscoted with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered),

title: Ezekiel 41:17
text: [and] above, over the entry, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about, within and without, [all was] by measure.

title: Ezekiel 41:18
text: And it was made with cherubim and palm-trees, and a palm-tree was between cherub and cherub; and the cherub had two faces:

title: Ezekiel 41:19
text: the face of a man was toward the palm-tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm-tree on the other side: [so] was it made upon all the house round about.

title: Ezekiel 41:20
text: From the ground unto above the entry were the cherubim and the palm-trees made, and [on] the wall of the temple.

title: Ezekiel 41:21
text: As for the temple, the door-posts were squared; and the front of the sanctuary had the same appearance.

title: Ezekiel 41:22
text: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits; and its corners, and its length, and its walls were of wood. And he said unto me, This is the table which is before Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 41:23
text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

title: Ezekiel 41:24
text: And the doors had two leaves, two turning-leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

title: Ezekiel 41:25
text: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubim and palm-trees, as there were made upon the walls; and there was a wooden portal in front of the porch without,

title: Ezekiel 41:26
text: and closed windows and palm-trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch and the side chambers of the house and the portals.

title: Ezekiel 42:1
text: ¶And he brought me forth into the outer court, the way toward the north; and he brought me to the cells that were over against the separate place and which were over against the building, toward the north,

title: Ezekiel 42:2
text: before the length of the hundred cubits: the entry was on the north, and the breadth was fifty cubits,

title: Ezekiel 42:3
text: over against the twenty [cubits] that pertained to the inner court, and over against the pavement that pertained to the outer court; there was gallery against gallery in the third [story];

title: Ezekiel 42:4
text: and before the cells was a walk of ten cubits in breadth, [and] a way of a hundred cubits inward; and their entries were toward the north.

title: Ezekiel 42:5
text: And the upper cells, because the galleries encroached on them, were shorter than the lower, and than the middle-most of the building.

title: Ezekiel 42:6
text: For they were in three [stories], but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts; therefore [the third story] was straitened more than the lowest and the middle-most from the ground.

title: Ezekiel 42:7
text: And the wall that was without, answering to the cells, toward the outer court in the front of the cells, its length was fifty cubits:

title: Ezekiel 42:8
text: for the length of the cells that were against the outer court was fifty cubits; but behold, before the temple it was a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 42:9
text: And under these cells was the entry from the east, as one goeth into them from the outer court.

title: Ezekiel 42:10
text: In the breadth of the wall of the court toward the south, before the separate place, and before the building, were cells;

title: Ezekiel 42:11
text: and a passage before them, like the appearance of the cells that were toward the north, according to their length, according to their breadth and all their goings out, and according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

title: Ezekiel 42:12
text: And according to the doors of the cells that were toward the south there was a door at the head of the way, the way directly before the corresponding wall toward the east as one entereth into them.

title: Ezekiel 42:13
text: And he said unto me, The north cells [and] the south cells, which are before the separate place, they are holy cells, where the priests that come near unto Jehovah shall eat the most holy things; there shall they lay the most holy things, both the oblation and the sin-offering and the trespass-offering: for the place is holy.

title: Ezekiel 42:14
text: When the priests enter in, they shall not go forth from the sanctuary into the outer court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister, for they are holy; and they shall put on other garments, and shall approach to that which is for the people.

title: Ezekiel 42:15
text: ¶And when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose front was toward the east, and measured [the enclosure] round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:16
text: He measured the east side with the measuring-reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring-reed round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:17
text: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring-reed round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:18
text: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring-reed.

title: Ezekiel 42:19
text: He turned about to the west side, [and] measured five hundred reeds with the measuring-reed.

title: Ezekiel 42:20
text: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall round about, five hundred long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

title: Ezekiel 43:1
text: ¶And he brought me unto the gate, the gate which looked toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:2
text: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east; and his voice was like the voice of many waters; and the earth was lit up with his glory.

title: Ezekiel 43:3
text: And the appearance of the vision that I saw was according to the vision that I had seen when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar: and I fell upon my face.

title: Ezekiel 43:4
text: And the glory of Jehovah came into the house by the way of the gate whose front was toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:5
text: And the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the glory of Jehovah filled the house.

title: Ezekiel 43:6
text: And I heard one speaking unto me out of the house; and a man was standing by me.

title: Ezekiel 43:7
text: ¶And he said unto me, Son of man, [this is] the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever; and the house of Israel shall no more defile my holy name, they nor their kings, with their fornication, and with the carcases of their kings [in] their high places,

title: Ezekiel 43:8
text: in that they set their threshold by my threshold, and their post by my post, and [there was only] a wall between me and them, and they defiled my holy name with their abominations which they committed; and I consumed them in mine anger.

title: Ezekiel 43:9
text: Now let them put away their fornication, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

title: Ezekiel 43:10
text: Thou, son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be confounded at their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

title: Ezekiel 43:11
text: And if they be confounded at all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, and its fashion, and its goings out, and its comings in, and all its forms, and all its statutes, yea, all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the statutes thereof, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 43:12
text: This is the law of the house: Upon the top of the mountain all its border round about is most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

title: Ezekiel 43:13
text: ¶And these are the measures of the altar in cubits: the cubit is a cubit and a hand breadth. The bottom was a cubit [in height] and the breadth a cubit, and its border on the edge thereof round about, one span: and this was the base of the altar.

title: Ezekiel 43:14
text: And from the bottom upon the ground to the lower settle was two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the small settle to the great settle, four cubits, and the breadth a cubit.

title: Ezekiel 43:15
text: And the upper altar was four cubits; and from the hearth of *God and upward were four horns.

title: Ezekiel 43:16
text: And the hearth of *God was twelve [cubits] long, by twelve broad, square in the four sides thereof.

title: Ezekiel 43:17
text: And the settle was fourteen [cubits] long by fourteen broad in the four sides thereof; and the border about it, half a cubit; and the bottom thereof a cubit round about: and its steps looked toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:18
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer up burnt-offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

title: Ezekiel 43:19
text: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that are of the seed of Zadok, who come near unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord Jehovah, a young bullock for a sin-offering.

title: Ezekiel 43:20
text: And thou shalt take of its blood, and put it on the four horns thereof, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: so shalt thou purge and make atonement for it.

title: Ezekiel 43:21
text: And thou shalt take the bullock of the sin-offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.

title: Ezekiel 43:22
text: And on the second day thou shalt present a he-goat without blemish for a sin-offering; and they shall purge the altar, as they purged it with the bullock.

title: Ezekiel 43:23
text: When thou hast ended purging it, thou shalt present a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish;

title: Ezekiel 43:24
text: and thou shalt present them before Jehovah; and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 43:25
text: Seven days shalt thou offer daily a goat for a sin-offering; they shall also offer a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

title: Ezekiel 43:26
text: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it, and consecrate it.

title: Ezekiel 43:27
text: And when these days are ended, it shall be that upon the eighth day and onwards the priests shall offer your burnt-offerings upon the altar, and your peace-offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 44:1
text: ¶And he brought me back toward the outer gate of the sanctuary which looked toward the east; and it was shut.

title: Ezekiel 44:2
text: And Jehovah said unto me, This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter in by it: for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it; and it shall be shut.

title: Ezekiel 44:3
text: As for the prince, he, the prince, shall sit in it to eat bread before Jehovah: he shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

title: Ezekiel 44:4
text: ¶And he brought me the way of the north gate before the house; and I beheld, and lo, the glory of Jehovah filled the house of Jehovah: and I fell upon my face.

title: Ezekiel 44:5
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Son of man, apply thy heart, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the statutes of the house of Jehovah, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary;

title: Ezekiel 44:6
text: and say to the rebellious, to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Let it suffice you of all your abominations, O house of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 44:7
text: in that ye have brought strangers, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, [even] my house, when ye offered my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant besides all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 44:8
text: And ye have not kept the charge of my holy things, but have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

title: Ezekiel 44:9
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: No stranger, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 44:10
text: ¶But the Levites who went away far from me, when Israel went astray, going astray from me after their idols, they shall even bear their iniquity;

title: Ezekiel 44:11
text: but they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and doing the service of the house: they shall slaughter the burnt-offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

title: Ezekiel 44:12
text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and were unto the house of Israel a stumbling-block of iniquity; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, saith the Lord Jehovah, that they shall bear their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 44:13
