text: Seventy weeks are apportioned out upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to close the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make expiation for iniquity, and to bring in the righteousness of the ages, and to seal the vision and prophet, and to anoint the holy of holies.

title: Daniel 9:25
text: Know therefore and understand: From the going forth of the word to restore and to build Jerusalem unto Messiah, the Prince, are seven weeks, and sixty-two weeks. The street and the moat shall be built again, even in troublous times.

title: Daniel 9:26
text: And after the sixty-two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, and shall have nothing; and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with an overflow, and unto the end, war, --the desolations determined.

title: Daniel 9:27
text: And he shall confirm a covenant with the many [for] one week; and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and because of the protection of abominations [there shall be] a desolator, even until that the consumption and what is determined shall be poured out upon the desolate.

title: Daniel 10:1
text: ¶In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing is true, but the appointed time of trial is long; and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

title: Daniel 10:2
text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks:

title: Daniel 10:3
text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three full weeks were fulfilled.

title: Daniel 10:4
text: And on the four-and-twentieth day of the first month, I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel:

title: Daniel 10:5
text: and I lifted up mine eyes and looked, and behold, a certain man clothed in linen, and his loins were girded with pure gold of Uphaz;

title: Daniel 10:6
text: and his body was like a chrysolite, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as torches of fire, and his arms and his feet as the look of burnished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

title: Daniel 10:7
text: And I Daniel alone saw the vision; and the men that were with me saw not the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

title: Daniel 10:8
text: And I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; and my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

title: Daniel 10:9
text: And I heard the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, I fell into a deep stupor on my face, and my face to the ground.

title: Daniel 10:10
text: ¶And behold, a hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and the palms of my hands.

title: Daniel 10:11
text: And he said unto me, O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words which I speak unto thee, and stand upright; for unto thee am I now sent. And as he spoke this word unto me, I stood trembling.

title: Daniel 10:12
text: And he said unto me, Fear not, Daniel; for from the first day that thou didst set thy heart to understand, and to humble thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come because of thy words.

title: Daniel 10:13
text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days; and behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

title: Daniel 10:14
text: And I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people at the end of the days: for the vision is yet for [many] days.

title: Daniel 10:15
text: And as he was speaking with me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

title: Daniel 10:16
text: And behold, one after the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips; and I opened my mouth and spoke, and said unto him that stood before me, My lord, by reason of the vision my pains are turned upon me, and I retain no strength.

title: Daniel 10:17
text: And how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remaineth no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

title: Daniel 10:18
text: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me;

title: Daniel 10:19
text: and he said, Fear not, man greatly beloved; peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And as he was speaking with me I was strengthened, and I said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

title: Daniel 10:20
text: And he said, Knowest thou wherefore I am come unto thee? And now I return to fight with the prince of Persia; and when I go forth, behold, the prince of Greece shall come.

title: Daniel 10:21
text: However, I will declare unto thee that which is set down in the scripture of truth; and there is not one that sheweth himself strong with me against these, but Michael your prince.

title: Daniel 11:1
text: ¶And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

title: Daniel 11:2
text: And now will I declare unto thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall enrich himself with great riches more than all; and when he hath become strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.

title: Daniel 11:3
text: And a mighty king shall stand up that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

title: Daniel 11:4
text: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of the heavens; but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion wherewith he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside these.

title: Daniel 11:5
text: ¶And the king of the south, who is one of his princes, shall be strong; but [another] shall be stronger than he, and have dominion: his dominion shall be a great dominion.

title: Daniel 11:6
text: And after the course of years they shall join affinity; and the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make equitable conditions: but she shall not retain the strength of her arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm; and she shall be given up, she and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in [those] times.

title: Daniel 11:7
text: But out of a shoot from her roots shall one stand up in his place, who shall come to the army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shew himself mighty.

title: Daniel 11:8
text: He shall also carry captive into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall subsist for more years than the king of the north;

title: Daniel 11:9
text: and [the same] shall come into the realm of the king of the south, but shall return into his own land.

title: Daniel 11:10
text: And his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces; and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through; and he shall return and carry the war even to his fortress.

title: Daniel 11:11
text: And the king of the south shall be enraged, and shall come forth and fight with him, with the king of the north, who shall set forth a great multitude, but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

title: Daniel 11:12
text: And when the multitude shall have been taken away, his heart shall be exalted; and he shall cast down myriads; but he shall not prevail.

title: Daniel 11:13
text: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former; and shall certainly come at the end of the times of years with a great army and with much substance.

title: Daniel 11:14
text: And in those times shall many stand up against the king of the south; and the violent of thy people will exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

title: Daniel 11:15
text: And the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take the well-fenced city; and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, for there shall be no strength to withstand.

title: Daniel 11:16
text: And he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the land of beauty, and destruction shall be in his hand.

title: Daniel 11:17
text: And he shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; and he shall practise; and he shall give him the daughter of women, to corrupt her; but she shall not stand, neither shall she be for him.

title: Daniel 11:18
text: And he shall turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many; but a captain for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease: he shall turn it upon him, without reproach for himself.

title: Daniel 11:19
text: And he shall turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; and he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

title: Daniel 11:20
text: And in his place shall one stand up who shall cause the exactor to pass through the glory of the kingdom; but in a few days he shall be broken, neither in anger nor in battle.

title: Daniel 11:21
text: ¶And in his place shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom; but he shall come in peaceably and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

title: Daniel 11:22
text: And the overflowing forces shall be overflowed from before him, and shall be broken: yea, also the prince of the covenant.

title: Daniel 11:23
text: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully, and he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

title: Daniel 11:24
text: In time of peace shall he enter even into the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers: he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance, and he shall plan his devices against the fortified places, even for a time.

title: Daniel 11:25
text: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall engage in battle with an exceeding great and mighty army; but he shall not stand, for they shall plan devices against him.

title: Daniel 11:26
text: And they that eat of his delicate food shall break him, and his army shall be dissolved; and many shall fall down slain.

title: Daniel 11:27
text: And both these kings' hearts [shall meditate] mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper; for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

title: Daniel 11:28
text: And he shall return into his land with great substance; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall practise, and return to his own land.

title: Daniel 11:29
text: At the set time he shall return, and come towards the south; but not as the former time shall be the latter;

title: Daniel 11:30
text: for ships of Chittim shall come against him; and he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant; and will practise; and he shall return and direct his attention to those that forsake the holy covenant.

title: Daniel 11:31
text: And forces shall stand on his part, and they shall profane the sanctuary, the fortress, and shall take away the continual [sacrifice], and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

title: Daniel 11:32
text: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he pervert by flatteries; but the people that know their God shall be strong, and shall act.

title: Daniel 11:33
text: And they that are wise among the people shall instruct the many; and they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, [many] days.

title: Daniel 11:34
text: And when they fall, they shall be helped with a little help; but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

title: Daniel 11:35
text: And [some] of the wise shall fall, to try them, and to purge and to make them white, to the time of the end: for it shall yet be for the time appointed.

title: Daniel 11:36
text: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every *god, and speak monstrous things against the *God of *gods; and he shall prosper until the indignation be accomplished: for that which is determined shall be done.

title: Daniel 11:37
text: And he will not regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women; nor regard any +god: for he will magnify himself above all.

title: Daniel 11:38
text: And in his place will he honour the +god of fortresses; and a +god whom his fathers knew not will he honour with gold and silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

title: Daniel 11:39
text: And he will practise in the strongholds of fortresses with a strange +god: whoso acknowledgeth him will he increase with glory; and he shall cause them to rule over the many, and shall divide the land [to them] for a reward.

title: Daniel 11:40
text: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and overflow and pass through.

title: Daniel 11:41
text: And he shall enter into the land of beauty, and many [countries] shall be overthrown; but these shall escape out of his hand: Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

title: Daniel 11:42
text: And he shall stretch forth his hand upon the countries; and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

title: Daniel 11:43
text: And he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

title: Daniel 11:44
text: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him; and he shall go forth with great fury to exterminate, and utterly to destroy many.

title: Daniel 11:45
text: And he shall plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the mountain of holy beauty; and he shall come to his end, and there shall be none to help him.

title: Daniel 12:1
text: ¶And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who standeth for the children of thy people; and there shall be a time of distress, such as never was since there was a nation until that time. And at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that is found written in the book.

title: Daniel 12:2
text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame, to everlasting contempt.

title: Daniel 12:3
text: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the expanse; and they that turn the many to righteousness as the stars, for ever and ever.

title: Daniel 12:4
text: And thou, Daniel, close the words, and seal the book, till the time of the end. Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

title: Daniel 12:5
text: ¶And I Daniel looked, and behold, there stood other two, the one on this side, on the bank of the river, and the other on that side, on the bank of the river.

title: Daniel 12:6
text: And he said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, How long [is it to] the end of these wonders?

title: Daniel 12:7
text: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river; and he held up his right hand and his left hand unto the heavens, and swore by him that liveth for ever that it is for a time, times, and a half; and when the scattering of the power of the holy people shall be accomplished, all these things shall be finished.

title: Daniel 12:8
text: And I heard, but I understood not. And I said, My lord, what shall be the end of these things?

title: Daniel 12:9
text: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel; for these words are closed and sealed till the time of the end.

title: Daniel 12:10
text: Many shall be purified, and be made white, and be refined; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

title: Daniel 12:11
text: And from the time that the continual [sacrifice] is taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, [there shall be] a thousand, two hundred, and ninety days.

title: Daniel 12:12
text: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and thirty-five days!

title: Daniel 12:13
text: But do thou go thy way until the end; and thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

title: Hosea 1:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

title: Hosea 1:2
text: ¶The beginning of the word of Jehovah through Hosea. And Jehovah said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms, and children of whoredoms; for the land is entirely given up to whoredom, away from Jehovah.

title: Hosea 1:3
text: And he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived and bore him a son.

title: Hosea 1:4
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Call his name Jizreel; for yet a little, and I will visit the blood of Jizreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

title: Hosea 1:5
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jizreel.

title: Hosea 1:6
text: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And he said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah; for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel, so that I should pardon them.

title: Hosea 1:7
text: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by Jehovah their God; and I will not save them by bow, or by sword, or by battle, [or] by horses, or by horsemen.

title: Hosea 1:8
text: ¶And she weaned Lo-ruhamah; and she conceived and bore a son;

title: Hosea 1:9
text: and he said, Call his name Lo-ammi; for ye are not my people, and I will not be for you.

title: Hosea 1:10
text: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea which cannot be measured or numbered; and it shall come to pass, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, it shall be said unto them, Sons of the living *God.

title: Hosea 1:11
text: And the children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint themselves one head, and shall go up out of the land: for great is the day of Jizreel.

title: Hosea 2:1
text: ¶Say unto your brethren Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.

title: Hosea 2:2
text: Plead with your mother, plead; for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: and let her put away her whoredoms from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

title: Hosea 2:3
text: lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her as a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

title: Hosea 2:4
text: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they are the children of whoredoms.

title: Hosea 2:5
text: For their mother hath played the harlot; she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give [me] my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

title: Hosea 2:6
text: ¶Therefore behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns; and I will fence [her] in with a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

title: Hosea 2:7
text: And she shall pursue after her lovers, and shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, and shall not find them: and she shall say, I will go and return to my first husband, for then was it better with me than now.

title: Hosea 2:8
text: And she did not know that I had given her the corn and the new wine and the oil, and had multiplied to her the silver and gold, which they employed for Baal.

title: Hosea 2:9
text: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my new wine in its season, and will withdraw my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

title: Hosea 2:10
text: And now will I discover her impiety in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.

title: Hosea 2:11
text: And I will cause all her mirth to cease: her feasts, her new moons, and her sabbaths! and all her solemnities.

title: Hosea 2:12
text: And I will make desolate her vine and her fig-tree, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards which my lovers have given me; and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

title: Hosea 2:13
text: And I will visit upon her the days of the Baals, wherein she burned incense to them, and decked herself with her rings and jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgot me, saith Jehovah.

title: Hosea 2:14
text: ¶Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak to her heart.

title: Hosea 2:15
text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

title: Hosea 2:16
text: And it shall be in that day, saith Jehovah, [that] thou shalt call me, My husband, and shalt call me no more, Baali;

title: Hosea 2:17
text: for I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

title: Hosea 2:18
text: And I will make a covenant for them in that day with the beasts of the field, and with the fowl of the heavens, and the creeping things of the ground; and I will break bow and sword and battle out of the land; and I will make them to lie down safely.

title: Hosea 2:19
text: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; and I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loving-kindness, and in mercies;

title: Hosea 2:20
text: and I will betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know Jehovah.

title: Hosea 2:21
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith Jehovah, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

title: Hosea 2:22
text: and the earth shall hear the corn, and the new wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jizreel.

title: Hosea 2:23
text: And I will sow her unto me in the land; and I will have mercy upon Lo-ruhamah; and I will say to Lo-ammi, Thou art my people; and they shall say, My God.

title: Hosea 3:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said unto me, Go again, love a woman beloved of a friend, and an adulteress, according to the love of Jehovah for the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love raisin-cakes.

title: Hosea 3:2
text: So I bought her to me for fifteen silver [pieces], and for a homer of barley, and a half-homer of barley.

title: Hosea 3:3
text: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be [another] man's, and I will also be for thee.

title: Hosea 3:4
text: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without statue, and without ephod and teraphim.

title: Hosea 3:5
text: Afterwards shall the children of Israel return, and seek Jehovah their God, and David their king; and shall turn with fear toward Jehovah and toward his goodness, at the end of the days.

title: Hosea 4:1
text: ¶Hear the word of Jehovah, ye children of Israel; for Jehovah hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land; for there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

title: Hosea 4:2
text: Swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, --they break out; and blood toucheth blood.

title: Hosea 4:3
text: For this shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowl of the heavens, yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

title: Hosea 4:4
text: Yet let no man strive, and let no man reprove; for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

title: Hosea 4:5
text: And thou shalt stumble by day; and the prophet also shall stumble with thee by night: and I will destroy thy mother.

title: Hosea 4:6
text: ¶My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; for thou hast rejected knowledge, and I will reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me; seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.

title: Hosea 4:7
text: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.

title: Hosea 4:8
text: They eat the sin of my people, and their soul longeth for their iniquity.

title: Hosea 4:9
text: And it shall be as the people so the priest; and I will visit their ways upon them, and recompense to them their doings;

title: Hosea 4:10
text: and they shall eat, and not have enough; they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: for they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.

title: Hosea 4:11
text: Fornication, and wine, and new wine take away the heart.

title: Hosea 4:12
text: ¶My people ask counsel of their stock, and their staff declareth unto them; for the spirit of whoredoms causeth [them] to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God:

title: Hosea 4:13
text: they sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oak and poplar and terebinth, because the shade thereof is good; therefore your daughters play the harlot and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

title: Hosea 4:14
text: I will not punish your daughters when they play the harlot, nor your daughters-in-law for their committing adultery; for they themselves go aside with harlots, and they sacrifice with prostitutes: and the people that doth not understand shall come to ruin.

title: Hosea 4:15
text: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, let not Judah trespass; and come ye not unto Gilgal, neither go up to Beth-aven, nor swear [As] Jehovah liveth!

title: Hosea 4:16
text: For Israel is refractory as an untractable heifer; now will Jehovah feed them as a lamb in a wide [pasture].

title: Hosea 4:17
text: --Ephraim is joined to idols: leave him alone.

title: Hosea 4:18
text: Their drink is sour; they give themselves up to whoredom; her great men passionately love [their] shame.

title: Hosea 4:19
text: The wind hath wrapped her up in its wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

title: Hosea 5:1
text: ¶Hear this, ye priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ear, O house of the king: for this judgment is for you; for ye have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

title: Hosea 5:2
text: And they have plunged themselves in the corruption of apostasy, but I will be a chastiser of them all.

title: Hosea 5:3
text: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me; for now, Ephraim, thou hast committed whoredom; Israel is defiled.

title: Hosea 5:4
text: Their doings do not allow them to return unto their God; for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they know not Jehovah.

title: Hosea 5:5
text: And Israel's pride doth testify to his face; and Israel and Ephraim shall fall by their iniquity: Judah also shall fall with them.

title: Hosea 5:6
text: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Jehovah; but they shall not find [him]: he hath withdrawn himself from them.

title: Hosea 5:7
text: They have dealt treacherously against Jehovah; for they have begotten strange children: now shall the new moon devour them, with their allotted possessions.

title: Hosea 5:8
text: ¶Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; cry aloud [at] Beth-aven: behind thee, O Benjamin!

title: Hosea 5:9
text: Ephraim shall be a desolation in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which is sure.

title: Hosea 5:10
text: The princes of Judah are become like them that remove the landmark: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

title: Hosea 5:11
text: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because in selfwill he walked after the commandment [of man].

title: Hosea 5:12
text: And I will be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

title: Hosea 5:13
text: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sore, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb; but he was unable to heal you, nor hath he removed your sore.

title: Hosea 5:14
text: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah. I, I will tear and go away; I will carry off, and there shall be none to deliver.

title: Hosea 5:15
text: I will go away, I will return to my place, till they acknowledge their trespass, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

title: Hosea 6:1
text: ¶Come and let us return unto Jehovah: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

title: Hosea 6:2
text: After two days will he revive us; on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live before his face;

title: Hosea 6:3
text: and we shall know, --we shall follow on to know Jehovah: his going forth is assured as the morning dawn; and he will come unto us as the rain, as the latter rain which watereth the earth.

title: Hosea 6:4
text: ¶What shall I do unto thee, Ephraim? What shall I do unto thee, Judah? For your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the dew that early passeth away.

title: Hosea 6:5
text: Therefore have I hewed [them] by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and my judgment goeth forth as the light.

title: Hosea 6:6
text: For I delight in loving-kindness, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.

title: Hosea 6:7
text: But they like Adam have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

title: Hosea 6:8
text: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity; it is tracked with blood.

title: Hosea 6:9
text: And as troops of robbers lie in wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way of Shechem; yea, they commit lewdness.

title: Hosea 6:10
text: In the house of Israel have I seen a horrible thing: the whoredom of Ephraim is there; Israel is defiled.

title: Hosea 6:11
text: Also, for thee, Judah, is a harvest appointed, when I shall turn again the captivity of my people.

title: Hosea 7:1
text: ¶When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they practise falsehood; and the thief entereth in, [and] the troop of robbers assaileth without.

title: Hosea 7:2
text: And they say not in their hearts [that] I remember all their wickedness: now do their own doings encompass them; they are before my face.

title: Hosea 7:3
text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

title: Hosea 7:4
text: They all practise adultery, as an oven heated by the baker: he ceaseth from stirring [the fire] after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

title: Hosea 7:5
text: In the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine: he stretched out his hand to scorners.

title: Hosea 7:6
text: For they have applied their heart like an oven to their lying in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth like a flaming fire.

title: Hosea 7:7
text: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

title: Hosea 7:8
text: ¶Ephraim, he mixeth himself with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

title: Hosea 7:9
text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth [it] not; yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, and he knoweth [it] not.

title: Hosea 7:10
text: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face; and they do not return to Jehovah their God, nor seek him for all this.

title: Hosea 7:11
text: And Ephraim is become like a silly dove without understanding: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

title: Hosea 7:12
text: When they go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowl of the heavens; I will chastise them, according as their assembly hath heard.

title: Hosea 7:13
text: Woe unto them! for they have wandered from me; destruction unto them! for they have transgressed against me. And I would redeem them; but they speak lies against me.

title: Hosea 7:14
text: And they cried not unto me in their heart, when they howled upon their beds; they assemble themselves for corn and new wine; they have turned aside from me.

title: Hosea 7:15
text: I have indeed trained, I have strengthened their arms, but they imagine mischief against me.

title: Hosea 7:16
text: They return, [but] not to the [Most] High: they are like a deceitful bow. Their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

title: Hosea 8:1
text: ¶Set the trumpet to thy mouth. [He cometh] as an eagle against the house of Jehovah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and rebelled against my law.

title: Hosea 8:2
text: They shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee; [we], Israel.

title: Hosea 8:3
text: Israel hath cast off good: the enemy shall pursue him.

title: Hosea 8:4
text: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not; of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

title: Hosea 8:5
text: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast [thee] off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will they be incapable of purity?

title: Hosea 8:6
text: For from Israel is this also: --a workman made it, and it is no God: for the calf of Samaria shall be [broken in] pieces.

title: Hosea 8:7
text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk; should it sprout, it would yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.

title: Hosea 8:8
text: ¶Israel is swallowed up: now are they become among the nations as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

title: Hosea 8:9
text: For they are gone up [to] Assyria [as] a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

title: Hosea 8:10
text: Although they hire among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall begin to be straitened under the burden of the king of princes.

title: Hosea 8:11
text: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

title: Hosea 8:12
text: I have prescribed unto him the manifold things of my law: they are counted [as] a strange thing.

title: Hosea 8:13
text: They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; Jehovah hath no delight in them. Now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

title: Hosea 8:14
text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

title: Hosea 9:1
text: ¶Rejoice not, Israel, exultingly, as the peoples; for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved harlot's hire upon every corn-floor.

title: Hosea 9:2
text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail her.

title: Hosea 9:3
text: They shall not dwell in Jehovah's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and in Assyria shall they eat that which is unclean.

title: Hosea 9:4
text: They shall pour out no [offerings of] wine to Jehovah, neither shall their sacrifices be pleasing unto him: they shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be defiled: for their bread shall be for themselves; it shall not come into the house of Jehovah.

title: Hosea 9:5
text: What will ye do in the day of assembly, and in the day of the feast of Jehovah?

title: Hosea 9:6
text: For behold, they are gone away because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Moph shall bury them: their pleasant things of silver, nettles shall possess them; thorns shall be in their tents.

title: Hosea 9:7
text: ¶The days of visitation are come; the days of recompence are come: Israel shall know [it]: the prophet is a fool, the inspired man is mad, because of the greatness of thine iniquity, and the great enmity.

title: Hosea 9:8
text: Is Ephraim a watchman with my God? [nay] the prophet is a fowler's snare on all his ways, enmity in the house of his God.

title: Hosea 9:9
text: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

title: Hosea 9:10
text: I found Israel as grapes in the wilderness; as first-ripe fruit on the fig-tree, I saw your fathers at the beginning: they went to Baal-Peor, and separated themselves unto that shame, and became abominations like their lover.

title: Hosea 9:11
text: ¶As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away as a bird, --no birth, no pregnancy, no conception!

title: Hosea 9:12
text: For even should they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, [that] not a man [remain]: for woe also to them when I shall have departed from them!

title: Hosea 9:13
text: Ephraim, as I saw [him], was a Tyre planted in a beautiful place; but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the slayer.

title: Hosea 9:14
text: Give them, Jehovah--what wilt thou give? --give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

title: Hosea 9:15
text: All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them: because of the wickedness of their doings, I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are rebellious.

title: Hosea 9:16
text: Ephraim is smitten: their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit; yea, though they should bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved [fruit] of their womb.

title: Hosea 9:17
text: My God hath rejected them, because they hearkened not unto him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

title: Hosea 10:1
text: ¶Israel is an unpruned vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly statues.

title: Hosea 10:2
text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will break down their altars, he will destroy their statues.

title: Hosea 10:3
text: For now they will say, We have no king, for we feared not Jehovah; and a king, what can he do for us?

title: Hosea 10:4
text: They speak [mere] words, swearing falsely in making a covenant; therefore shall judgment spring up as hemlock in the furrows of the fields.

title: Hosea 10:5
text: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calf of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the idolatrous priests thereof shall tremble for it, for its glory, because it is departed from it.

title: Hosea 10:6
text: Yea, it shall be carried unto Assyria [as] a present for king Jareb: Ephraim shall be seized with shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

title: Hosea 10:7
text: As for Samaria her king is cut off as chips upon the face of the waters.

title: Hosea 10:8
text: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up upon their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us! and to the hills, Fall on us!

title: Hosea 10:9
text: ¶From the days of Gibeah hast thou sinned, O Israel: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

title: Hosea 10:10
text: At my pleasure will I chastise them; and the peoples shall be assembled against them, when they are bound for their two iniquities.

title: Hosea 10:11
text: And Ephraim is a trained heifer, that loveth to tread out [the corn]; I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to draw; Judah shall plough, Jacob shall break his clods.

title: Hosea 10:12
text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

title: Hosea 10:13
text: Ye have ploughed wickedness, reaped iniquity, eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst confide in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

title: Hosea 10:14
text: And a tumult shall arise among thy peoples, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with the children.

title: Hosea 10:15
text: So shall Bethel do unto you because of the wickedness of your wickedness: at day-break shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

title: Hosea 11:1
text: ¶When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

title: Hosea 11:2
text: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baals, and burned incense to graven images.

title: Hosea 11:3
text: And I it was that taught Ephraim to walk, --He took them upon his arms, --but they knew not that I healed them.

title: Hosea 11:4
text: I drew them with bands of a man, with cords of love; and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I gently caused them to eat.

title: Hosea 11:5
text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king; for they refused to return [to me];

title: Hosea 11:6
text: and the sword shall turn about in his cities, and shall consume his bars, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.

title: Hosea 11:7
text: Yea, my people are bent upon backsliding from me: though they call them to the Most High, none at all exalteth [him].

title: Hosea 11:8
text: ¶How shall I give thee over, Ephraim? [how] shall I deliver thee up, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboim? My heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

title: Hosea 11:9
text: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not again destroy Ephraim; for I am *God, and not man, --the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not come in anger.

title: Hosea 11:10
text: They shall walk after Jehovah; he shall roar like a lion; when he shall roar, then the children shall hasten from the west:

title: Hosea 11:11
text: they shall hasten as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will cause them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.

title: Hosea 11:12
text: Ephraim encompasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet walketh with *God, and with the holy things of truth.

title: Hosea 12:1
text: ¶Ephraim feedeth on wind, and pursueth after the east wind: all day long he multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

title: Hosea 12:2
text: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and he will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

title: Hosea 12:3
text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and in his strength he wrestled with God.

title: Hosea 12:4
text: Yea, he wrestled with the Angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spoke with us,

title: Hosea 12:5
text: --even Jehovah, the God of hosts, --Jehovah is his memorial.

title: Hosea 12:6
text: And thou, return unto thy God: keep loving-kindness and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

title: Hosea 12:7
text: ¶[He is] a merchant, balances of deceit are in his hand; he loveth to oppress.

title: Hosea 12:8
text: And Ephraim saith, Nevertheless I am become rich, I have found me out substance; in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

title: Hosea 12:9
text: But I [that am] Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt will again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

title: Hosea 12:10
text: And I have spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and by means of the prophets have I used similitudes.

title: Hosea 12:11
text: If Gilead is iniquity, surely they are but vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

title: Hosea 12:12
text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].

title: Hosea 12:13
text: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

title: Hosea 12:14
text: Ephraim provoked [him] to anger most bitterly; and his Lord shall leave his blood upon him, and recompense unto him his reproach.

title: Hosea 13:1
text: ¶When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel: but he trespassed through Baal, and he died.

title: Hosea 13:2
text: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

title: Hosea 13:3
text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing-floor, and as the smoke out of the lattice.

title: Hosea 13:4
text: Yet I [am] Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou hast known no God but me; and there is no saviour besides me.

title: Hosea 13:5
text: ¶I knew thee in the wilderness, in the land of drought.

title: Hosea 13:6
text: According to their pasture, they became full; they became full, and their heart was exalted: therefore have they forgotten me.

title: Hosea 13:7
text: And I will be unto them as a lion; as a leopard I will lurk for them by the way;

title: Hosea 13:8
text: I will meet them as a bear bereaved of her [whelps], and will rend the covering of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lioness: the beast of the field shall tear them.

title: Hosea 13:9
text: ¶It is thy destruction, O Israel, that [thou art] against me, against thy help.

title: Hosea 13:10
text: Where then is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes? --

title: Hosea 13:11
text: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

title: Hosea 13:12
text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid by in store.

title: Hosea 13:13
text: The pangs of a woman in travail shall come upon him: he is a son not wise; for at the time of the breaking forth of children, he was not there.

title: Hosea 13:14
text: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death: where, O death, are thy plagues? where, O Sheol, is thy destruction? Repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

title: Hosea 13:15
text: Though he be fruitful among [his] brethren, an east wind shall come, a wind of Jehovah [that] cometh up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

title: Hosea 13:16
text: Samaria shall bear her guilt; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword; their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

title: Hosea 14:1
text: ¶O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

title: Hosea 14:2
text: Take with you words, and turn to Jehovah; say unto him, Forgive all iniquity, and receive [us] graciously; so will we render the calves of our lips.

title: Hosea 14:3
text: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, [Thou art] our God; because in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

title: Hosea 14:4
text: ¶I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.

title: Hosea 14:5
text: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:6
text: His shoots shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:7
text: They shall return and sit under his shadow; they shall revive [as] corn, and blossom as the vine: the renown thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:8
text: ¶Ephraim [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols? (I answer [him], and I will observe him.) I am like a green fir-tree. --From me is thy fruit found.

title: Hosea 14:9
text: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? intelligent, and he shall know them? For the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but the transgressors shall fall therein.

title: Joel 1:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

title: Joel 1:2
text: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

title: Joel 1:3
text: Tell your children of it, and [let] your children [tell] their children, and their children another generation:

title: Joel 1:4
text: that which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten.

title: Joel 1:5
text: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine: for it is cut off from your mouth.

title: Joel 1:6
text: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong and without number: his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a lioness.

title: Joel 1:7
text: He hath made my vine a desolation, and barked my fig-tree; he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away: its branches are made white.

title: Joel 1:8
text: ¶Wail like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

title: Joel 1:9
text: The oblation and the drink-offering are cut off from the house of Jehovah; the priests, Jehovah's ministers, mourn.

title: Joel 1:10
text: The field is laid waste, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted, the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

title: Joel 1:11
text: Be ashamed, ye husbandmen; howl, ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley: because the harvest of the field hath perished.

title: Joel 1:12
text: The vine is dried up, and the fig-tree languisheth; the pomegranate-tree, the palm also and the apple-tree; all the trees of the field are withered, yea, joy is withered away from the children of men.

title: Joel 1:13
text: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests; howl, ministers of the altar; come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the oblation and the drink-offering are withholden from the house of your God.

title: Joel 1:14
text: ¶Hallow a fast, proclaim a solemn assembly, gather the elders, [and] all the inhabitants of the land to the house of Jehovah your God, and cry unto Jehovah.

title: Joel 1:15
text: Alas for the day! for the day of Jehovah is at hand, and as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

title: Joel 1:16
text: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

title: Joel 1:17
text: The seeds are rotten under their clods, the granaries are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

title: Joel 1:18
text: How do the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are bewildered, for they have no pasture; the flocks of sheep also are in suffering.

title: Joel 1:19
text: To thee, Jehovah, do I cry; for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned up all the trees of the field.

title: Joel 1:20
text: The beasts of the field also cry unto thee; for the water-courses are dried, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

title: Joel 2:1
text: ¶Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain; let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of Jehovah cometh, for it is at hand;

title: Joel 2:2
text: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and gross darkness, as the dawn spread upon the mountains; --a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after them, to the years of generations and generations.

title: Joel 2:3
text: A fire devoureth before them, and behind them a flame burneth; the land is as a garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness: yea, and nothing escapeth them.

title: Joel 2:4
text: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so they run.

title: Joel 2:5
text: Like the noise of chariots, on the tops of the mountains, they leap; like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

title: Joel 2:6
text: Before them the peoples are in anguish: all faces turn pale.

title: Joel 2:7
text: They run like mighty men; they climb the wall like men of war; and they march every one on his ways, and break not their ranks.

title: Joel 2:8
text: Neither doth one press upon another; they march every one in his path; and fall amid weapons, but are not wounded.

title: Joel 2:9
text: They spread themselves over the city; they run upon the wall; they climb up into the houses; they enter in by the windows like a thief.

title: Joel 2:10
text: The earth quaketh before them; the heavens tremble; the sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

title: Joel 2:11
text: And Jehovah uttereth his voice before his army; for his camp is very great; for strong is he that executeth his word: for the day of Jehovah is great and very terrible; and who can bear it?

title: Joel 2:12
text: ¶Yet even now, saith Jehovah, turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning;

title: Joel 2:13
text: and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Jehovah your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving-kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

title: Joel 2:14
text: Who knoweth? He might return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him, an oblation and a drink-offering for Jehovah your God?

title: Joel 2:15
text: Blow the trumpet in Zion, hallow a fast, proclaim a solemn assembly;

title: Joel 2:16
text: gather the people, hallow the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts; let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, and the bride from her closet.

title: Joel 2:17
text: Let the priests, the ministers of Jehovah, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare, O Jehovah, thy people, and give not thine inheritance to reproach, that they should be a byword of the nations. Wherefore should they say among the peoples, Where is their God?

title: Joel 2:18
text: ¶Then Jehovah will be jealous for his land, and will have pity on his people.

title: Joel 2:19
text: And Jehovah will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I send you corn, and new wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

title: Joel 2:20
text: And I will remove far off from you him [that cometh] from the north, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, his face toward the eastern sea, and his rear toward the hinder sea; and his stench shall come up, and his ill odour shall come up, for he hath exalted himself to do great things.

title: Joel 2:21
text: --Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for Jehovah doeth great things.

title: Joel 2:22
text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring; for the tree beareth its fruit; the fig-tree and the vine yield full increase.

title: Joel 2:23
text: And ye, children of Zion, be glad and rejoice in Jehovah your God; for he giveth you the early rain in due measure, and he causeth to come down for you the rain, the early rain, and the latter rain at the beginning [of the season].

title: Joel 2:24
text: And the floors shall be full of corn, and the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil.

title: Joel 2:25
text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer-worm, my great army which I sent among you.

title: Joel 2:26
text: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of Jehovah your God, who hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

title: Joel 2:27
text: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I, Jehovah, [am] your God, and there is none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

title: Joel 2:28
text: ¶And it shall come to pass afterwards [that] I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions.

title: Joel 2:29
text: Yea, even upon the bondmen and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my Spirit.

title: Joel 2:30
text: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

title: Joel 2:31
text: The sun shall be changed to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the great and terrible day of Jehovah come.

title: Joel 2:32
text: And it shall be that whosoever shall call upon the name of Jehovah shall be saved: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as Jehovah hath said, and for the residue whom Jehovah shall call.

title: Joel 3:1
text: ¶For behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall turn again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

title: Joel 3:2
text: I will also gather all the nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and I will enter into judgment with them there on account of my people and mine inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations: and they have parted my land;

title: Joel 3:3
text: and they have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a harlot, and sold a girl for wine, and have drunk [it].

title: Joel 3:4
text: Yea also, what have ye to do with me, O Tyre and Zidon, and all the districts of Philistia? Will ye render me a recompence? But if ye recompense me, swiftly [and] speedily will I bring your recompence upon your own head;

title: Joel 3:5
text: because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my beautiful pleasant things,

title: Joel 3:6
text: and the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the children of the Greeks, that ye might remove them far from their border.

title: Joel 3:7
text: Behold, I will raise them up out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will bring your recompence upon your own head.

title: Joel 3:8
text: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a nation far off: for Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Joel 3:9
text: ¶Proclaim this among the nations: prepare war, arouse the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near, let them come up.

title: Joel 3:10
text: Beat your ploughshares into swords, and your pruning-knives into spears; let the weak say, I am strong.

title: Joel 3:11
text: Haste ye and come, all ye nations round about, and gather yourselves together. Thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Jehovah.

title: Joel 3:12
text: Let the nations rouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the nations round about.

title: Joel 3:13
text: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down, for the press is full, the vats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

title: Joel 3:14
text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Jehovah is at hand in the valley of decision.

title: Joel 3:15
text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

title: Joel 3:16
text: And Jehovah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: and Jehovah will be a shelter for his people, and the refuge of the children of Israel.

title: Joel 3:17
text: And ye shall know that I, Jehovah, [am] your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain; and Jerusalem shall be holy, and no strangers shall pass through her any more.

title: Joel 3:18
text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the water-courses of Judah shall flow with waters; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of Jehovah, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

title: Joel 3:19
text: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, in that they have shed innocent blood in their land.

title: Joel 3:20
text: But Judah shall abide for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

title: Joel 3:21
text: And I will purge them from the blood from which I had not purged them: for Jehovah dwelleth in Zion.

title: Amos 1:1
text: ¶The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

title: Amos 1:2
text: And he said, Jehovah roareth from Zion, and uttereth his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withereth.

title: Amos 1:3
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not revoke [my sentence], because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron.

title: Amos 1:4
text: And I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-Hadad.

title: Amos 1:5
text: And I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Beth-Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 1:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gazah, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver [them] up to Edom.

title: Amos 1:7
text: And I will send a fire on the wall of Gazah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

title: Amos 1:8
text: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 1:9
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant.

title: Amos 1:10
text: And I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

title: Amos 1:11
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because he pursued his brother with the sword, and cast off all pity; and his anger did tear continually, and he kept his wrath for ever.

title: Amos 1:12
text: And I will send a fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

title: Amos 1:13
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border.

title: Amos 1:14
text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind.

title: Amos 1:15
text: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:1
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

title: Amos 2:2
text: And I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerijoth; and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, [and] with the sound of the trumpet.

title: Amos 2:3
text: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:4
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they have despised the law of Jehovah, and have not kept his statutes; and their lies have caused them to err, after which their fathers walked.

title: Amos 2:5
text: And I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

title: Amos 2:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes;

title: Amos 2:7
text: panting after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turning aside the way of the meek; and a man and his father will go in unto the [same] maid, to profane my holy name.

title: Amos 2:8
text: And they lay [themselves] down by every altar upon clothes taken in pledge, and they drink [in] the house of their God the wine of the condemned.

title: Amos 2:9
text: ¶But I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was as the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; but I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

title: Amos 2:10
text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

title: Amos 2:11
text: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, ye children of Israel? saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:12
text: And ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

title: Amos 2:13
text: Behold, I will press upon you, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.

title: Amos 2:14
text: And flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver his soul.

title: Amos 2:15
text: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and the swift of foot shall not escape, and he that rideth the horse shall not deliver his soul;

title: Amos 2:16
text: and he that is stout-hearted among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 3:1
text: ¶Hear this word that Jehovah hath spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Amos 3:2
text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore will I visit upon you all your iniquities.

title: Amos 3:3
text: Shall two walk together except they be agreed?

title: Amos 3:4
text: Will a lion roar in the forest when he hath no prey? Will a young lion cry out of his den if he have taken nothing?

title: Amos 3:5
text: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth when no gin [is laid] for him? Will the snare spring up from the earth when nothing at all hath been taken?

title: Amos 3:6
text: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? Shall there be evil in a city, and Jehovah not have done [it]?

title: Amos 3:7
text: But the Lord Jehovah will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.

title: Amos 3:8
text: The lion hath roared, --who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken, --who can but prophesy?

title: Amos 3:9
text: ¶Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great uproar in the midst thereof, and the oppressions that are within her:

title: Amos 3:10
text: and they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and plunder in their palaces.

title: Amos 3:11
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An adversary! --even round about the land! And he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be pillaged.

title: Amos 3:12
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Like as the shepherd rescueth out of the jaw of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be rescued that sit in Samaria in the corner of a couch, and upon the damask of a bed.

title: Amos 3:13
text: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts,

title: Amos 3:14
text: that in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

title: Amos 3:15
text: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and many houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:1
text: ¶Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, that oppress the poor, that crush the needy, that say to their lords, Bring, and let us drink:

title: Amos 4:2
text: the Lord Jehovah hath sworn by his holiness, that behold, days shall come upon you, when he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fish-hooks;

title: Amos 4:3
text: and ye shall go out by the breaches, every one straight before her, and ye shall be cast out to Harmon, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:4
text: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices in the morning, your tithes every three days,

title: Amos 4:5
text: and burn a thank-offering with leaven, and proclaim, publish, voluntary offerings: for this pleaseth you, children of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:6
text: ¶And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places; yet ye have not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:7
text: And I also have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece [of land] was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

title: Amos 4:8
text: And two, three, cities wandered unto one city, to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:9
text: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew; the palmer-worm hath devoured the multitude of your gardens, and your vineyards, and your fig-trees and your olive-trees: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:10
text: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, taking away captive your horses; and I made the stench of your camps to come up, even into your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:11
text: I have overthrown among you, like God's overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a brand plucked out of the burning; yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:12
text: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

title: Amos 4:13
text: For behold, he who formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, who maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, --Jehovah, the God of hosts, is his name.

title: Amos 5:1
text: ¶Hear this word, a lamentation, which I take up against you, O house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:2
text: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more arise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

title: Amos 5:3
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, for the house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:4
text: ¶For thus saith Jehovah unto the house of Israel: Seek ye me, and ye shall live.

title: Amos 5:5
text: And seek not Bethel, neither go to Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.

title: Amos 5:6
text: Seek Jehovah, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour [it], and there be none to quench [it] in Bethel.

title: Amos 5:7
text: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,

title: Amos 5:8
text: [seek him] that made the Pleiades and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night; that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: Jehovah is his name.

title: Amos 5:9
text: He causeth destruction to break forth suddenly upon the strong, and bringeth destruction upon the fortress.

title: Amos 5:10
text: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

title: Amos 5:11
text: Forasmuch, therefore, as ye trample upon the poor, and take from him presents of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, and ye shall not drink the wine of them.

title: Amos 5:12
text: For I know how manifold are your transgressions and your sins mighty: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside [the right of] the needy in the gate.

title: Amos 5:13
text: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in this time; for it is an evil time.

title: Amos 5:14
text: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye say.

title: Amos 5:15
text: Hate evil, and love good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

title: Amos 5:16
text: ¶Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, the Lord: Wailing shall be in all broadways; and they shall say in all the streets, Alas! alas! And they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

title: Amos 5:17
text: And in all vineyards shall be wailing; for I will pass through the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 5:18
text: Woe unto you that desire the day of Jehovah! To what end is the day of Jehovah for you? It shall be darkness and not light:

title: Amos 5:19
text: as if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

title: Amos 5:20
text: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

title: Amos 5:21
text: ¶I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will not smell [a sweet odour] in your solemn assemblies.

title: Amos 5:22
text: For if ye offer up unto me burnt-offerings and your oblations, I will not accept [them]; neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fatted beasts.

title: Amos 5:23
text: Take away from me the noise of thy songs, and I will not hear the melody of thy lutes;

title: Amos 5:24
text: but let judgment roll down as waters, and righteousness as an ever-flowing stream.

title: Amos 5:25
text: Did ye bring unto me sacrifices and oblations in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

title: Amos 5:26
text: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of your Moloch, and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye had made to yourselves;

title: Amos 5:27
text: and I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith Jehovah, whose name is the God of hosts.

title: Amos 6:1
text: ¶Woe to them that are at ease in Zion and that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, the renowned of the first of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come.

title: Amos 6:2
text: Pass unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go to Hamath the great; and go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

title: Amos 6:3
text: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

title: Amos 6:4
text: that lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves from the midst of the stall;

title: Amos 6:5
text: that chant to the sound of the lute, [and] invent them instruments of music, like David;

title: Amos 6:6
text: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments; but are not grieved for the breach of Joseph.

title: Amos 6:7
text: Therefore shall they now go captive, with the first that go captive, and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.

title: Amos 6:8
text: ¶The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by himself, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, I abhor the pride of Jacob, and hate his palaces; and I will deliver up the city with all that is therein.

title: Amos 6:9
text: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

title: Amos 6:10
text: And a man's uncle, and he that should burn him, shall take him up to bring out the bones from the house, and shall say unto him that is in the inner parts of the house, Is there yet [any] with thee? and he shall say, None. And he will say, Silence! for we may not make mention of Jehovah's name.

title: Amos 6:11
text: For behold, Jehovah commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

title: Amos 6:12
text: Shall horses run upon the rock? will [men] plough [thereon] with oxen? For ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood,

title: Amos 6:13
text: --ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us power by our own strength?

title: Amos 6:14
text: For behold, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah the God of hosts, I will raise up against you a nation; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the torrent of the Arabah.

title: Amos 7:1
text: ¶Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth, and behold, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

title: Amos 7:2
text: And it came to pass, when they had wholly eaten the grass of the land, that I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

title: Amos 7:3
text: Jehovah repented for this: It shall not be, said Jehovah.

title: Amos 7:4
text: Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, the Lord Jehovah called to contend by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and ate up the inheritance.

title: Amos 7:5
text: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

title: Amos 7:6
text: Jehovah repented for this: This also shall not be, said the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 7:7
text: Thus did he shew unto me; and behold, the Lord stood upon a wall [made] by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.

title: Amos 7:8
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumb-line. And the Lord said, Behold, I will set a plumb-line in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more.

title: Amos 7:9
text: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolated, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will arise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

title: Amos 7:10
text: ¶Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

title: Amos 7:11
text: For thus Amos saith: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall certainly go into captivity out of his land.

title: Amos 7:12
text: And Amaziah said unto Amos, [Thou] seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and eat bread there, and prophesy there.
