title: Amos 7:13
text: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel; for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is the house of the kingdom.

title: Amos 7:14
text: And Amos answered and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was a herdman, and a gatherer of sycamore fruit.

title: Amos 7:15
text: And Jehovah took me as I followed the flock, and Jehovah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

title: Amos 7:16
text: And now hear thou the word of Jehovah: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and utter not [words] against the house of Isaac.

title: Amos 7:17
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided with the line; and thou shalt die in a land that is unclean; and Israel shall certainly go into captivity, out of his land.

title: Amos 8:1
text: ¶Thus did Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, a basket of summer-fruit.

title: Amos 8:2
text: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer-fruit. And Jehovah said unto me, The end is come upon my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more.

title: Amos 8:3
text: And the songs of the palace shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah. The dead bodies shall be many; in every place they shall be cast forth. Silence!

title: Amos 8:4
text: ¶Hear this, ye that pant after the needy, even to cause to fail the poor of the land,

title: Amos 8:5
text: saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat? making the ephah small and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances for deceit:

title: Amos 8:6
text: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; and that we may sell the refuse of the wheat.

title: Amos 8:7
text: Jehovah hath sworn by the glory of Jacob, Certainly I will never forget any of their works.

title: Amos 8:8
text: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? And it shall wholly rise up like the Nile; and it shall surge and sink down, as the river of Egypt.

title: Amos 8:9
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the land in the clear day.

title: Amos 8:10
text: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning for an only [son], and the end thereof as a bitter day.

title: Amos 8:11
text: ¶Behold, days come, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I will send a famine in the land; not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Jehovah.

title: Amos 8:12
text: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, and shall not find it.

title: Amos 8:13
text: In that day shall the fair virgins and the young men faint for thirst;

title: Amos 8:14
text: they that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, [As] thy god, O Dan, liveth! and, [As] the way of Beer-sheba liveth! even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

title: Amos 9:1
text: ¶I saw the Lord standing upon the altar; and he said, Smite the chapiter that the thresholds may shake; and break all of them in pieces, in the head; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not get away by flight, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

title: Amos 9:2
text: Though they dig into Sheol, thence shall my hand take them; and though they climb up to the heavens, thence will I bring them down;

title: Amos 9:3
text: and though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there will I command the serpent, and it shall bite them;

title: Amos 9:4
text: and though they go into captivity before their enemies, there will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

title: Amos 9:5
text: And the Lord Jehovah of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it melteth, and all that dwell therein shall mourn; and it shall wholly rise up like the Nile, and sink down as the river of Egypt.

title: Amos 9:6
text: It is he that buildeth his upper chambers in the heavens, and hath founded his vault upon the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: Jehovah is his name.

title: Amos 9:7
text: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith Jehovah. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

title: Amos 9:8
text: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth: only that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 9:9
text: For behold, I command, and I will shake the house of Israel to and fro among all the nations, like as one shaketh [corn] in a sieve; yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

title: Amos 9:10
text: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, Evil shall not overtake nor befall us.

title: Amos 9:11
text: ¶In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David which is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

title: Amos 9:12
text: that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and all the nations upon whom my name is called, saith Jehovah who doeth this.

title: Amos 9:13
text: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, when the ploughman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop new wine, and all the hills shall melt.

title: Amos 9:14
text: And I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; and they shall make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

title: Amos 9:15
text: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them, saith Jehovah thy God.

title: Obadiah 1:1
text: ¶The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning Edom: We have heard a report from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations. Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

title: Obadiah 1:2
text: Behold, I have made thee small among the nations; thou art greatly despised.

title: Obadiah 1:3
text: The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; --he that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

title: Obadiah 1:4
text: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith Jehovah.

title: Obadiah 1:5
text: If thieves had come to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen [till] they had had enough? If grape-gatherers had come to thee, would they not have left some gleanings?

title: Obadiah 1:6
text: How is Esau searched! his hidden things sought out!

title: Obadiah 1:7
text: All the men of thy confederacy have pushed thee to the border; the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, they have prevailed against thee; [they that eat] thy bread have laid a snare under thee. There is no understanding in him.

title: Obadiah 1:8
text: Shall I not in that day, saith Jehovah, destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

title: Obadiah 1:9
text: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.

title: Obadiah 1:10
text: ¶Because of violence against thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

title: Obadiah 1:11
text: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away captive his substance, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

title: Obadiah 1:12
text: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day of his disaster; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; nor have opened wide thy mouth in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:13
text: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity, nor have looked, even thou, on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither shouldest thou have laid [hands] on their substance in the day of their calamity;

title: Obadiah 1:14
text: and thou shouldest not have stood on the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape, nor have delivered up those remaining of him in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:15
text: For the day of Jehovah is near upon all the nations: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy recompence shall return upon thine own head.

title: Obadiah 1:16
text: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the nations drink continually; yea, they shall drink, and shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

title: Obadiah 1:17
text: ¶But upon mount Zion shall there be deliverance, and it shall be holy; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

title: Obadiah 1:18
text: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble; and they shall kindle in them and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau: for Jehovah hath spoken [it].

title: Obadiah 1:19
text: And [they of] the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the lowland the Philistines; yea, they shall possess the field of Ephraim and the field of Samaria; and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead;

title: Obadiah 1:20
text: and the captives of this host of the children of Israel [shall possess] what belonged to the Canaanites, unto Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who [were] in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

title: Obadiah 1:21
text: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion, to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's.

title: Jonah 1:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

title: Jonah 1:2
text: Arise, go to Nineveh, the great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

title: Jonah 1:3
text: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah; and he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish, from the presence of Jehovah.

title: Jonah 1:4
text: ¶But Jehovah sent out a great wind upon the sea, and there was a mighty tempest upon the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

title: Jonah 1:5
text: And the mariners were afraid, and cried every one unto his god; and they cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to be lightened of them. But Jonah had gone down into the lower part of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

title: Jonah 1:6
text: And the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, sleeper? arise, call upon thy God; perhaps God will think upon us, that we perish not.

title: Jonah 1:7
text: And they said each one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. And they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

title: Jonah 1:8
text: And they said unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us: what is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

title: Jonah 1:9
text: And he said unto them, I am a Hebrew, and I fear Jehovah, the God of the heavens, who hath made the sea and the dry [land].

title: Jonah 1:10
text: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, What is this thou hast done? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of Jehovah: for he had told them.

title: Jonah 1:11
text: ¶And they said unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea grew more and more tempestuous.

title: Jonah 1:12
text: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that because of me this great tempest is upon you.

title: Jonah 1:13
text: But the men rowed hard to regain the land; but they could not; for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.

title: Jonah 1:14
text: And they cried unto Jehovah and said, Ah, Jehovah, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, Jehovah, hast done as it pleased thee.

title: Jonah 1:15
text: And they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from its raging.

title: Jonah 1:16
text: And the men feared Jehovah exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto Jehovah, and made vows.

title: Jonah 1:17
text: And Jehovah prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

title: Jonah 2:1
text: ¶And Jonah prayed unto Jehovah his God out of the fish's belly;

title: Jonah 2:2
text: and he said: I cried by reason of my distress unto Jehovah, and he answered me; Out of the belly of Sheol cried I: thou heardest my voice.

title: Jonah 2:3
text: For thou didst cast me into the depth, into the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me: All thy breakers and thy billows are gone over me.

title: Jonah 2:4
text: And I said, I am cast out from before thine eyes, Yet will I look again toward thy holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:5
text: The waters encompassed me, to the soul: The deep was round about me, The weeds were wrapped about my head.

title: Jonah 2:6
text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The bars of the earth [closed] upon me for ever: But thou hast brought up my life from the pit, O Jehovah my God.

title: Jonah 2:7
text: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Jehovah; And my prayer came in unto thee, Into thy holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:8
text: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

title: Jonah 2:9
text: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is of Jehovah.

title: Jonah 2:10
text: ¶And Jehovah commanded the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry [land].

title: Jonah 3:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

title: Jonah 3:2
text: Arise, go to Nineveh, the great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I shall bid thee.

title: Jonah 3:3
text: And Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of Jehovah. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

title: Jonah 3:4
text: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!

title: Jonah 3:5
text: ¶And the men of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

title: Jonah 3:6
text: And the word reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and laid his robe from him, and covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

title: Jonah 3:7
text: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything: let them not feed, nor drink water;

title: Jonah 3:8
text: and let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God; and let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

title: Jonah 3:9
text: Who knoweth but that God will turn and repent, and will turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

title: Jonah 3:10
text: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil that he had said he would do unto them, and he did [it] not.

title: Jonah 4:1
text: ¶And it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

title: Jonah 4:2
text: And he prayed unto Jehovah, and said, Ah, Jehovah, was not this my saying when I was yet in my country? Therefore I was minded to flee at first unto Tarshish; for I knew that thou art a gracious *God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving-kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

title: Jonah 4:3
text: And now, Jehovah, take, I beseech thee, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.

title: Jonah 4:4
text: And Jehovah said, Doest thou well to be angry?

title: Jonah 4:5
text: ¶And Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shade, till he might see what would become of the city.

title: Jonah 4:6
text: And Jehovah Elohim prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his trouble. And Jonah was exceeding glad because of the gourd.

title: Jonah 4:7
text: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.

title: Jonah 4:8
text: And it came to pass, when the sun arose, that God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, so that he fainted; and he requested for himself that he might die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

title: Jonah 4:9
text: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, unto death.

title: Jonah 4:10
text: And Jehovah said, Thou hast pity on the gourd, for which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

title: Jonah 4:11
text: and I, should not I have pity on Nineveh, the great city, wherein are more than a hundred and twenty thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

title: Micah 1:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:2
text: Hear, ye peoples, all of you; hearken, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Jehovah be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple!

title: Micah 1:3
text: For behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

title: Micah 1:4
text: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, as waters poured down a steep place.

title: Micah 1:5
text: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. Whence is the transgression of Jacob? is it not [from] Samaria? And whence are the high places of Judah? are they not [from] Jerusalem?

title: Micah 1:6
text: Therefore will I make Samaria as a heap of the field, as plantings of a vineyard; and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will lay bare the foundations thereof.

title: Micah 1:7
text: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her harlot-gifts shall be burned with fire, and all her idols will I make a desolation; for of the hire of a harlot hath she gathered [them], and to a harlot's hire shall they return.

title: Micah 1:8
text: ¶For this will I lament, and I will howl; I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the jackals, and mourning like the ostriches.

title: Micah 1:9
text: For her wounds are incurable; for it is come even unto Judah, it reacheth unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:10
text: Tell it not in Gath, weep not at all; at Beth-le-aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

title: Micah 1:11
text: Pass away, inhabitress of Shaphir, in nakedness [and] shame. The inhabitress of Zaanan is not come forth for the lamentation of Beth-ezel: he will take from you its shelter.

title: Micah 1:12
text: For the inhabitress of Maroth waited anxiously for good; but evil hath come down from Jehovah unto the gate of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:13
text: Bind the chariot to the swift steed, O inhabitress of Lachish: she was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for in thee were found the transgressions of Israel.

title: Micah 1:14
text: Therefore shalt thou give parting-gifts to Moresheth-Gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

title: Micah 1:15
text: I will yet bring unto thee an heir, O inhabitress of Mareshah; the glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.

title: Micah 1:16
text: Make thee bald, and poll thee for the children of thy delights; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle, for they are gone into captivity from thee.

title: Micah 2:1
text: ¶Woe to them that devise iniquity and work evil upon their beds! When the morning is light they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

title: Micah 2:2
text: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away; and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

title: Micah 2:3
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye walk haughtily: for it is an evil time.

title: Micah 2:4
text: In that day shall they take up a proverb concerning you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, [and] say, We are utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! He hath distributed our fields to the rebellious.

title: Micah 2:5
text: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the measuring line upon a lot, in the congregation of Jehovah.

title: Micah 2:6
text: ¶Prophesy ye not, they prophesy. If they do not prophesy to these, the ignominy will not depart.

title: Micah 2:7
text: O thou [that art] named the house of Jacob, Is Jehovah impatient? are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

title: Micah 2:8
text: But of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye strip off the mantle with the garment from them that pass by securely, that are averse from war.

title: Micah 2:9
text: The women of my people do ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their young children do ye take away my magnificence for ever.

title: Micah 2:10
text: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not the resting-place, because of defilement that bringeth destruction, even a grievous destruction.

title: Micah 2:11
text: If a man walking in wind and falsehood do lie, [saying,] I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink, he shall be the prophet of this people.

title: Micah 2:12
text: ¶I will surely assemble, O Jacob, the whole of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture: they shall make great noise by reason of [the multitude of] men.

title: Micah 2:13
text: One that breaketh through is gone up before them: they have broken forth, and have passed on to the gate, and are gone out by it; and their king passeth on before them, and Jehovah at the head of them.

title: Micah 3:1
text: ¶And I said, Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know judgment?

title: Micah 3:2
text: Ye who hate the good, and love evil; who pluck off their skin from them, and their flesh from off their bones;

title: Micah 3:3
text: and who eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces as for the pot, and as flesh within the cauldron.

title: Micah 3:4
text: Then shall they cry unto Jehovah, but he will not answer them; and he will hide his face from them at that time, according as they have wrought evil in their doings.

title: Micah 3:5
text: Thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that cause my people to err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace! but whoso putteth not into their mouths they prepare war against him:

title: Micah 3:6
text: therefore ye shall have night without a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, without divination; and the sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them.

title: Micah 3:7
text: And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners confounded; and they shall all cover their lips, for there will be no answer of God.

title: Micah 3:8
text: ¶But truly I am filled with power by the Spirit of Jehovah, and with judgment and with might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

title: Micah 3:9
text: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity,

title: Micah 3:10
text: that build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with unrighteousness.

title: Micah 3:11
text: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money; yet do they lean upon Jehovah, and say, Is not Jehovah in the midst of us? no evil shall come upon us.

title: Micah 3:12
text: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be ploughed [as] a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

title: Micah 4:1
text: ¶But it shall come to pass in the end of days [that] the mountain of Jehovah's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be lifted up above the hills; and the peoples shall flow unto it.

title: Micah 4:2
text: And many nations shall go and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths. For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and Jehovah's word from Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:3
text: And he shall judge among many peoples, and reprove strong nations, even afar off; and they shall forge their swords into ploughshares, and their spears into pruning-knives: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

title: Micah 4:4
text: And they shall sit every one under his vine, and under his fig-tree; and there shall be none to make [them] afraid: for the mouth of Jehovah of hosts hath spoken [it].

title: Micah 4:5
text: For all the peoples will walk every one in the name of his god; but we will walk in the name of Jehovah, our God for ever and ever.

title: Micah 4:6
text: In that day, saith Jehovah, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

title: Micah 4:7
text: and I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation; and Jehovah shall reign over them in mount Zion, from henceforth even for ever.

title: Micah 4:8
text: ¶And thou, O tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, yea, the first dominion shall come, --the kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:9
text: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished, that pangs have seized thee as a woman in travail?

title: Micah 4:10
text: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon: there shalt thou be delivered; there Jehovah will redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

title: Micah 4:11
text: And now many nations are assembled against thee, that say, Let her be profaned, and let our eye look upon Zion.

title: Micah 4:12
text: But they know not the thoughts of Jehovah, neither understand they his counsel; for he hath gathered them together as the sheaves into the threshing-floor.

title: Micah 4:13
text: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass; and thou shalt beat in pieces many peoples; and I will devote their gain to Jehovah, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Micah 5:1
text: ¶Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops; he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

title: Micah 5:2
text: (And thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, little to be among the thousands of Judah, out of thee shall he come forth unto me [who is] to be Ruler in Israel: whose goings forth are from of old, from the days of eternity.)

title: Micah 5:3
text: Therefore will he give them up, until the time when she which travaileth shall have brought forth: and the residue of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

title: Micah 5:4
text: And he shall stand and feed [his flock] in the strength of Jehovah, in the majesty of the name of Jehovah his God. And they shall abide; for now shall he be great even unto the ends of the earth.

title: Micah 5:5
text: And this [man] shall be Peace. When the Assyrian shall come into our land, and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight princes of men.

title: Micah 5:6
text: And they shall waste the land of Asshur with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof; and he shall deliver [us] from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

title: Micah 5:7
text: ¶And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples as dew from Jehovah, as showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, neither waiteth for the sons of men.

title: Micah 5:8
text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and there is none to deliver.

title: Micah 5:9
text: Thy hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

title: Micah 5:10
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots.

title: Micah 5:11
text: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and overthrow all thy strongholds.

title: Micah 5:12
text: And I will cut off sorceries out of thy hand; and thou shalt have no soothsayers.

title: Micah 5:13
text: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy statues out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more bow down to the work of thy hands.

title: Micah 5:14
text: And I will pluck up thine Asherahs out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy cities.

title: Micah 5:15
text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and in fury upon the nations, such as they have not heard of.

title: Micah 6:1
text: ¶Hear ye now what Jehovah saith: Arise, contend before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

title: Micah 6:2
text: Hear, ye mountains, Jehovah's controversy, and ye, unchanging foundations of the earth; for Jehovah hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

title: Micah 6:3
text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

title: Micah 6:4
text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

title: Micah 6:5
text: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, from Shittim unto Gilgal, that ye may know the righteousness of Jehovah.

title: Micah 6:6
text: ¶Wherewith shall I come before Jehovah, bow myself before the high God? Shall I come before him with burnt-offerings, with calves of a year old?

title: Micah 6:7
text: Will Jehovah take pleasure in thousands of rams, in ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

title: Micah 6:8
text: He hath shewn thee, O man, what is good: and what doth Jehovah require of thee, but to do justly, and to love goodness, and to walk humbly with thy God?

title: Micah 6:9
text: ¶Jehovah's voice crieth unto the city, and wisdom looketh on thy name. Hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

title: Micah 6:10
text: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure [which is] abominable?

title: Micah 6:11
text: Shall I be pure with the unjust balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

title: Micah 6:12
text: For her rich men are full of violence, and her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

title: Micah 6:13
text: Therefore also will I make [thee] sick in smiting thee; I will make [thee] desolate because of thy sins.

title: Micah 6:14
text: Thou shalt eat, and not be satisfied, and thine emptiness [shall remain] in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take away, and not save; and what thou savest will I give up to the sword.

title: Micah 6:15
text: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and new wine, but shalt not drink wine.

title: Micah 6:16
text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab; and ye walk in their counsels: that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof a hissing; and ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

title: Micah 7:1
text: ¶Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer-fruits, as the grape-gleanings of the vintage. There is no cluster to eat; there is no early fruit [which] my soul desired.

title: Micah 7:2
text: The godly [man] hath perished out of the land, and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood, they hunt every man his brother with a net.

title: Micah 7:3
text: Both hands are for evil, to do it well. The prince asketh, and the judge [is there] for a reward; and the great [man] uttereth his soul's greed: and [together] they combine it.

title: Micah 7:4
text: The best of them is as a briar; the most upright, [worse] than a thorn-fence. The day of thy watchmen, thy visitation is come; now shall be their perplexity.

title: Micah 7:5
text: Believe ye not in a companion, put not confidence in a familiar friend: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

title: Micah 7:6
text: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law: a man's enemies are the men of his own household.

title: Micah 7:7
text: ¶But as for me, I will look unto Jehovah; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

title: Micah 7:8
text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: though I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Jehovah shall be a light unto me.

title: Micah 7:9
text: I will bear the indignation of Jehovah--for I have sinned against him--until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light; I shall behold his righteousness.

title: Micah 7:10
text: And mine enemy shall see [it], and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is Jehovah thy God? Mine eyes shall behold her; now shall she be trodden down, as the mire of the streets.

title: Micah 7:11
text: In the day when thy walls shall be built, on that day shall the established limit recede.

title: Micah 7:12
text: In that day they shall come to thee from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

title: Micah 7:13
text: But the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

title: Micah 7:14
text: ¶Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine inheritance, dwelling alone in the forest, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

title: Micah 7:15
text: --As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt, will I shew them marvellous things.

title: Micah 7:16
text: --The nations shall see, and be ashamed for all their might: they shall lay [their] hand upon [their] mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

title: Micah 7:17
text: They shall lick dust like the serpent; like crawling things of the earth, they shall come trembling forth from their close places. They shall turn with fear to Jehovah our God, and shall be afraid because of thee.

title: Micah 7:18
text: Who is a *God like unto thee, that forgiveth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? He retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in loving-kindness.

title: Micah 7:19
text: He will yet again have compassion on us, he will tread under foot our iniquities: and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

title: Micah 7:20
text: Thou wilt perform truth to Jacob, loving-kindness to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers, from the days of old.

title: Nahum 1:1
text: ¶The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

title: Nahum 1:2
text: ¶A jealous and avenging *God is Jehovah: an avenger is Jehovah, and full of fury: Jehovah taketh vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth [wrath] for his enemies.

title: Nahum 1:3
text: Jehovah is slow to anger, and great in power, and doth not at all clear [the guilty]: Jehovah, --his way is in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

title: Nahum 1:4
text: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

title: Nahum 1:5
text: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt, and the earth is upheaved at his presence, and the world, and all that dwell therein.

title: Nahum 1:6
text: Who shall stand before his indignation? and who shall abide in the fierceness of his anger? His fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken asunder by him.

title: Nahum 1:7
text: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

title: Nahum 1:8
text: But with an overrunning flood he will make a full end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

title: Nahum 1:9
text: ¶What do ye imagine against Jehovah? He will make a full end: trouble shall not rise up the second time.

title: Nahum 1:10
text: Though they be tangled together [as] thorns, and be as drenched from their drink, they shall be devoured as dry stubble, completely.

title: Nahum 1:11
text: Out of thee is gone forth one that imagineth evil against Jehovah, a wicked counsellor.

title: Nahum 1:12
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Though they be complete in number, and many as they be, even so shall they be cut down, and he shall pass away; and though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

title: Nahum 1:13
text: And now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds asunder.

title: Nahum 1:14
text: And Jehovah hath given commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy god will I cut off the graven image, and the molten image: I will prepare thy grave; for thou art vile.

title: Nahum 1:15
text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth glad tidings, that publisheth peace! Celebrate thy feasts, Judah, perform thy vows: for the wicked one shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

title: Nahum 2:1
text: ¶He that dasheth in pieces is come up against thy face: keep the fortress, watch the way, make [thy] loins strong, fortify [thy] power mightily.

title: Nahum 2:2
text: For Jehovah hath brought again the glory of Jacob, as the glory of Israel; for the wasters have wasted them, and marred their vine-branches.

title: Nahum 2:3
text: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots [glitter] with the sheen of steel, in the day of his preparation, and the spears are brandished.

title: Nahum 2:4
text: The chariots rush madly in the streets, they justle one against another in the broad ways: the appearance of them is like torches, they run like lightnings.

title: Nahum 2:5
text: He bethinketh him of his nobles: they stumble in their march; they make haste to the wall thereof, and the shelter is prepared.

title: Nahum 2:6
text: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace melteth away.

title: Nahum 2:7
text: And it is decreed: she shall be uncovered, she shall be led away, and her maids shall moan as with the voice of doves, drumming upon their breasts.

title: Nahum 2:8
text: Nineveh hath been like a pool of water, since the day she existed, yet they flee away. ...Stand! Stand! But none looketh back.

title: Nahum 2:9
text: Plunder the silver, plunder the gold; for there is no end of the splendid store of all precious vessels.

title: Nahum 2:10
text: She is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and writhing pain is in all loins, and all their faces grow pale.

title: Nahum 2:11
text: ¶Where is [now] the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion, the lioness, [and] the lion's whelp walked, and none made them afraid?

title: Nahum 2:12
text: The lion tore in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

title: Nahum 2:13
text: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts: and I will burn her chariots into smoke; and the sword shall devour thy young lions, and I will cut off thy prey from the earth; and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

title: Nahum 3:1
text: ¶Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies [and] violence; the prey departeth not.

title: Nahum 3:2
text: The crack of the whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the prancing horses, and of the bounding chariots!

title: Nahum 3:3
text: The horseman springing up, and the glitter of the sword, and the flash of the spear, and a multitude of slain, and a mass of carcases, and no end of corpses: they stumble over their corpses.

title: Nahum 3:4
text: --Because of the multitude of the fornications of the well-favoured harlot, mistress of sorceries, that selleth nations through her fornications, and families through her sorceries,

title: Nahum 3:5
text: behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts; and I will uncover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

title: Nahum 3:6
text: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazing stock.

title: Nahum 3:7
text: And it shall come to pass, [that] all they that see thee shall flee from thee, and shall say, Nineveh is laid waste! Who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

title: Nahum 3:8
text: ¶Art thou better than No-Amon, that was situate among the rivers, [that had] the waters round about her, whose rampart was the sea, [and] of the sea was her wall?

title: Nahum 3:9
text: Ethiopia was her strength, and Egypt, and it was infinite; Phut and the Libyans were her helpers.

title: Nahum 3:10
text: She too was carried away, she went into captivity: her infants also were dashed in pieces, at the top of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound with chains.

title: Nahum 3:11
text: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid; thou also shalt seek a refuge from the enemy.

title: Nahum 3:12
text: All thy strongholds are [like] fig-trees with the first-ripe figs: if they be shaken, they even fall into the mouth of the eater.

title: Nahum 3:13
text: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are [as] women: the gates of thy land are set wide open unto thine enemies; the fire devoureth thy bars.

title: Nahum 3:14
text: Draw thee water for the siege, strengthen thy fortresses; go into the clay, and tread the mortar, make strong the brick-kiln.

title: Nahum 3:15
text: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off; it shall devour thee like the cankerworm. Make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locust.

title: Nahum 3:16
text: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants more than the stars of the heavens; the cankerworm spreadeth himself out and flieth away.

title: Nahum 3:17
text: Thy chosen men are as the locusts, and thy captains as swarms of grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day: when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

title: Nahum 3:18
text: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; thy nobles lie still; thy people are scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

title: Nahum 3:19
text: There is no healing of thy breach; thy wound is grievous; all that hear the report of thee clap the hands over thee; for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

title: Habakkuk 1:1
text: ¶The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

title: Habakkuk 1:2
text: Jehovah, how long shall I cry and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee, Violence! and thou dost not save.

title: Habakkuk 1:3
text: Why dost thou cause me to see iniquity, and lookest thou upon grievance? For spoiling and violence are before me; and there is strife, and contention riseth up.

title: Habakkuk 1:4
text: Therefore the law is powerless, and justice doth never go forth; for the wicked encompasseth the righteous; therefore judgment goeth forth perverted.

title: Habakkuk 1:5
text: ¶See ye among the nations, and behold, and wonder marvellously; for [I] work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be declared [to you].

title: Habakkuk 1:6
text: For behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation, which marcheth through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.

title: Habakkuk 1:7
text: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

title: Habakkuk 1:8
text: And their horses are swifter than the leopards, and are more agile than the evening wolves; and their horsemen prance proudly, and their horsemen come from afar: they fly as an eagle that hasteth to devour.

title: Habakkuk 1:9
text: They come all of them for violence: the crowd of their faces is forwards, and they gather captives as the sand.

title: Habakkuk 1:10
text: Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a scorn unto him; he derideth every stronghold: for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.

title: Habakkuk 1:11
text: Then will his mind change, and he will pass on, and become guilty: this his power is become his +god.

title: Habakkuk 1:12
text: ¶--Art thou not from everlasting, Jehovah my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. Jehovah, thou hast ordained him for judgment; and thou, O Rock, hast appointed him for correction.

title: Habakkuk 1:13
text: [Thou art] of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on mischief: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, [and] keepest silence when the wicked swalloweth up a [man] more righteous than he?

title: Habakkuk 1:14
text: And thou makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them.

title: Habakkuk 1:15
text: He taketh up all of them with the hook, he catcheth them in his net, and gathereth them into his drag; therefore he rejoiceth and is glad:

title: Habakkuk 1:16
text: therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; for by them his portion is become fat, and his meat dainty.

title: Habakkuk 1:17
text: Shall he therefore empty his net, and not spare to slay the nations continually?

title: Habakkuk 2:1
text: ¶I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will look forth to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer as to my reproof.

title: Habakkuk 2:2
text: And Jehovah answered me and said, Write the vision, and engrave it upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it.

title: Habakkuk 2:3
text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but it hasteth to the end, and shall not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; for it will surely come, it will not delay.

title: Habakkuk 2:4
text: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright within him: but the just shall live by his faith.

title: Habakkuk 2:5
text: ¶And moreover, the wine is treacherous: he is a proud man, and keepeth not at rest, he enlargeth his desire as Sheol, and he is like death and cannot be satisfied; and he assembleth unto him all nations, and gathereth unto him all peoples.

title: Habakkuk 2:6
text: Shall not all these take up a proverb about him, and a taunting riddle against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? --and to him that loadeth himself with pledges!

title: Habakkuk 2:7
text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and they awake up that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

title: Habakkuk 2:8
text: Because thou hast plundered many nations, all the rest of the peoples shall plunder thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence [done] to the land, to the city, and all that dwell therein.

title: Habakkuk 2:9
text: Woe to him that getteth iniquitous gain to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the grasp of evil!

title: Habakkuk 2:10
text: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, by cutting off many peoples, and hast sinned against thine own soul.

title: Habakkuk 2:11
text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

title: Habakkuk 2:12
text: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by unrighteousness!

title: Habakkuk 2:13
text: Behold, is it not of Jehovah of hosts that the peoples labour for the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?

title: Habakkuk 2:14
text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Jehovah as the waters cover the sea.

title: Habakkuk 2:15
text: ¶Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, --that pourest out thy flask, and makest [him] drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

title: Habakkuk 2:16
text: Thou art filled with shame instead of glory; drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of Jehovah's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and a shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

title: Habakkuk 2:17
text: For the violence [done] to Lebanon shall cover thee, and the destruction of beasts which made them afraid; because of men's blood, and for the violence [done] to the land, to the city, and all that dwell therein.

title: Habakkuk 2:18
text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it? the molten image, and the teacher of falsehood, that the maker of his work dependeth thereon, to make dumb idols?

title: Habakkuk 2:19
text: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake! to the dumb stone, Arise! Shall it teach? Behold it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

title: Habakkuk 2:20
text: But Jehovah is in his holy temple. Let all the earth keep silence before him!

title: Habakkuk 3:1
text: ¶A Prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

title: Habakkuk 3:2
text: Jehovah, I heard the report of thee, [and] I feared. Jehovah, revive thy work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make [it] known: In wrath remember mercy!

title: Habakkuk 3:3
text: ¶+God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covereth the heavens, And the earth is full of his praise.

title: Habakkuk 3:4
text: And [his] brightness was as the light; Rays [came forth] from his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.

title: Habakkuk 3:5
text: Before him went the pestilence, And a burning flame went forth at his feet.

title: Habakkuk 3:6
text: He stood, and measured the earth; He beheld, and discomfited the nations; And the eternal mountains were scattered, The everlasting hills gave way: His ways are everlasting.

title: Habakkuk 3:7
text: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

title: Habakkuk 3:8
text: Was Jehovah wrathful with the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers? Was thy rage against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thy horses, Thy chariots of salvation?

title: Habakkuk 3:9
text: Thy bow was made naked, The rods [of discipline] sworn according to [thy] word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

title: Habakkuk 3:10
text: The mountains saw thee, they were in travail: Torrents of waters passed by; The deep uttered its voice, Lifted up its hands on high.

title: Habakkuk 3:11
text: The sun [and] moon stood still in their habitation, At the light of thine arrows which shot forth, --At the shining of thy glittering spear.

title: Habakkuk 3:12
text: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, Thou didst thresh the nations in anger.

title: Habakkuk 3:13
text: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou didst smite off the head from the house of the wicked, Laying bare the foundation even to the neck. Selah.

title: Habakkuk 3:14
text: Thou didst strike through with his own spears the head of his leaders: They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me, Whose exulting was as to devour the afflicted secretly.

title: Habakkuk 3:15
text: Thou didst walk through the sea with thy horses, The heap of great waters.

title: Habakkuk 3:16
text: ¶I heard, and my belly trembled; My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in my place, That I might rest in the day of distress, When their invader shall come up against the people.

title: Habakkuk 3:17
text: For though the fig-tree shall not blossom, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labour of the olive-tree shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:

title: Habakkuk 3:18
text: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

title: Habakkuk 3:19
text: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength, And he maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], And he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief Musician. On my stringed instruments.

title: Zephaniah 1:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

title: Zephaniah 1:2
text: I will utterly take away everything from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah:

title: Zephaniah 1:3
text: I will take away man and beast; I will take away the fowl of the heavens and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling-blocks with the wicked, and I will cut off mankind from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah.

title: Zephaniah 1:4
text: And I will stretch forth my hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, the name of the Chemarim with the priests;

title: Zephaniah 1:5
text: and them that bow down to the host of the heavens upon the housetops; and them that bow down to Jehovah, that swear by [him], and swear by Malcham;

title: Zephaniah 1:6
text: and them that turn back from after Jehovah, and that do not seek Jehovah, nor inquire for him.

title: Zephaniah 1:7
text: ¶Be silent at the presence of the Lord Jehovah; for the day of Jehovah is at hand; for Jehovah hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath hallowed his guests.

title: Zephaniah 1:8
text: And it shall come to pass in the day of Jehovah's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's sons, and all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.

title: Zephaniah 1:9
text: And in that day will I punish all those that leap over the threshold, who fill their master's house with violence and deceit.

title: Zephaniah 1:10
text: And in that day, saith Jehovah, there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish-gate, and a howling from the second [quarter], and a great crashing from the hills.

title: Zephaniah 1:11
text: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh; for all the people of Canaan are cut down, all they that are laden with silver are cut off.

title: Zephaniah 1:12
text: And it shall come to pass at that time, [that] I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and punish the men that are settled on their lees, that say in their heart, Jehovah will not do good, neither will he do evil.

title: Zephaniah 1:13
text: And their wealth shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation; and they shall build houses, and not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and not drink the wine thereof.

title: Zephaniah 1:14
text: ¶The great day of Jehovah is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly. The voice of the day of Jehovah: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

title: Zephaniah 1:15
text: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of ruin and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and gross darkness,

title: Zephaniah 1:16
text: a day of the trumpet and alarm, against the fenced cities and against the high battlements.

title: Zephaniah 1:17
text: And I will bring distress upon men, and they shall walk like blind men; for they have sinned against Jehovah; and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as dung:

title: Zephaniah 1:18
text: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them, in the day of Jehovah's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for a full end, yea, a sudden [end], shall he make of all them that dwell in the land.

title: Zephaniah 2:1
text: ¶Collect yourselves and gather together, O nation without shame,

title: Zephaniah 2:2
text: before the decree bring forth, [before] the day pass away as chaff, before the fierce anger of Jehovah come upon you, before the day of Jehovah's anger come upon you.

title: Zephaniah 2:3
text: Seek Jehovah, all ye meek of the land, who have performed his ordinance; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of Jehovah's anger.

title: Zephaniah 2:4
text: ¶For Gazah shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon shall be a desolation; they shall drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

title: Zephaniah 2:5
text: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea-coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of Jehovah is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: I will destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant;

title: Zephaniah 2:6
text: and the sea-coast shall be cave-dwellings for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

title: Zephaniah 2:7
text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for Jehovah their God shall visit them, and turn again their captivity.

title: Zephaniah 2:8
text: ¶I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

title: Zephaniah 2:9
text: Therefore, [as] I live, saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab shall certainly be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles, and salt-pits, and a perpetual desolation; the remnant of my people shall spoil them, and the residue of my nation shall possess them.

title: Zephaniah 2:10
text: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zephaniah 2:11
text: Jehovah will be terrible unto them; for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and all the isles of the nations shall worship him, every one from his place.

title: Zephaniah 2:12
text: ¶Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be the slain of my sword.

title: Zephaniah 2:13
text: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, a place of drought like the wilderness.

title: Zephaniah 2:14
text: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the crowd of beasts; both the pelican and the bittern shall lodge in the chapiters thereof; a voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be on the thresholds: for he hath laid bare the cedar work.

title: Zephaniah 2:15
text: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt in security, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none else beside me: how is she become a desolation, a couching-place for beasts! Every one that passeth by her shall hiss, shall wave his hand.

title: Zephaniah 3:1
text: ¶Woe to her that is rebellious and corrupted, to the oppressing city!

title: Zephaniah 3:2
text: She hearkened not to the voice; she received not correction; she confided not in Jehovah; she drew not near her God.

title: Zephaniah 3:3
text: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, that leave nothing for the morning.

title: Zephaniah 3:4
text: Her prophets are vain-glorious, treacherous persons; her priests profane the sanctuary, they do violence to the law.

title: Zephaniah 3:5
text: The righteous Jehovah is in the midst of her: he doeth no wrong. Every morning doth he bring his judgment to light; it faileth not: but the unrighteous knoweth no shame.

title: Zephaniah 3:6
text: I have cut off nations: their battlements are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by; their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

title: Zephaniah 3:7
text: I said, Only fear me, receive correction; so her dwelling shall not be cut off, howsoever I may punish her. But they rose early, they corrupted all their doings.

title: Zephaniah 3:8
text: ¶Therefore wait ye for me, saith Jehovah, until the day that I rise up to the prey; for my determination is to assemble the nations, that I may gather the kingdoms together, to pour upon them mine indignation, --all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

title: Zephaniah 3:9
text: For then will I turn to the peoples a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.

title: Zephaniah 3:10
text: From beyond the rivers of Cush my suppliants, the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine oblation.

title: Zephaniah 3:11
text: In that day thou shalt not be ashamed for all thy doings wherein thou hast transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that exult in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

title: Zephaniah 3:12
text: And I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Jehovah.

title: Zephaniah 3:13
text: The remnant of Israel shall not work unrighteousness, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: but *they* shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

title: Zephaniah 3:14
text: ¶Exult, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; rejoice and be glad with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem:

title: Zephaniah 3:15
text: Jehovah hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy; the King of Israel, Jehovah, is in the midst of thee; thou shalt not see evil any more.

title: Zephaniah 3:16
text: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear not; Zion, let not thy hands be slack.

title: Zephaniah 3:17
text: Jehovah thy God is in thy midst, a mighty one that will save: he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will exult over thee with singing.

title: Zephaniah 3:18
text: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assemblies, who were of thee: the reproach of it was a burden [unto them].

title: Zephaniah 3:19
text: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; and I will save her that halted, and gather her that was driven out; and I will make them a praise and a name in all the lands where they have been put to shame.

title: Zephaniah 3:20
text: At that time will I bring you, yea, at the time that I gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise, among all the peoples of the earth, when I shall turn again your captivity before your eyes, saith Jehovah.

title: Haggai 1:1
text: ¶In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, came the word of Jehovah by the prophet Haggai unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

title: Haggai 1:2
text: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that Jehovah's house should be built.

title: Haggai 1:3
text: And the word of Jehovah came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

title: Haggai 1:4
text: Is it time for you that ye should dwell in your wainscoted houses, while this house lieth waste?

title: Haggai 1:5
text: And now thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Consider your ways.

title: Haggai 1:6
text: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but are not satisfied; ye drink, but are not filled with drink; ye clothe yourselves, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages for a bag with holes.

title: Haggai 1:7
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Consider your ways.

title: Haggai 1:8
text: Go up to the mountain and bring wood, and build the house, and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith Jehovah.

title: Haggai 1:9
text: Ye looked for much, and behold it was little; and when ye brought it home, I blew upon it. Wherefore? saith Jehovah of hosts. Because of my house that lieth waste, whilst ye run every man to his own house.

title: Haggai 1:10
text: Therefore over you the heavens withhold their dew, and the earth withholdeth its fruit.

title: Haggai 1:11
text: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon man, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

title: Haggai 1:12
text: ¶And Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people, hearkened to the voice of Jehovah their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, according as Jehovah their God had sent him, and the people feared before Jehovah.

title: Haggai 1:13
text: Then spoke Haggai, Jehovah's messenger, in Jehovah's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith Jehovah.

title: Haggai 1:14
text: And Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked at the house of Jehovah of hosts, their God,

title: Haggai 1:15
text: in the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

title: Haggai 2:1
text: ¶In the seventh [month], on the one and twentieth [day] of the month, came the word of Jehovah by the prophet Haggai, saying,

title: Haggai 2:2
text: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

title: Haggai 2:3
text: Who is left among you that saw this house in its former glory? and how do ye see it now? Is it not as nothing in your eyes?

title: Haggai 2:4
text: But now be strong, Zerubbabel, saith Jehovah; and be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith Jehovah, and work: for I am with you, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:5
text: The word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, and my Spirit, remain among you: fear ye not.

title: Haggai 2:6
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry [land];

title: Haggai 2:7
text: and I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come; and I will fill this house with glory, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:8
text: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:9
text: The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former, saith Jehovah of hosts; and in this place will I give peace, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:10
text: ¶On the four and twentieth [day] of the ninth [month], in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet, saying,

title: Haggai 2:11
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Ask now the priests [concerning] the law, saying,

title: Haggai 2:12
text: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any food--shall it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

title: Haggai 2:13
text: And Haggai said, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, is it become unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

title: Haggai 2:14
text: Then answered Haggai and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith Jehovah, and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

title: Haggai 2:15
text: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and onward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of Jehovah,

title: Haggai 2:16
text: --before those [days] were, when one came to a heap of twenty [measures], there were but ten; when one came to the vat to draw out fifty press-measures, there were but twenty.

title: Haggai 2:17
text: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the work of your hands; and ye [turned] not to me, saith Jehovah.

title: Haggai 2:18
text: Consider, I pray you, from this day and onward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth [month], from the day that the foundation of Jehovah's temple was laid, consider [it].

title: Haggai 2:19
text: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, the vine, and the fig-tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive-tree have not brought forth: from this day will I bless [you].

title: Haggai 2:20
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came the second time unto Haggai on the four and twentieth [day] of the month, saying,

title: Haggai 2:21
text: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

title: Haggai 2:22
text: and I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride therein; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

title: Haggai 2:23
text: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, will I take thee, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant, saith Jehovah, and will make thee as a signet; for I have chosen thee, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zechariah 1:1
text: ¶In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah unto Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

title: Zechariah 1:2
text: Jehovah hath been very wroth with your fathers.

title: Zechariah 1:3
text: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Return unto me, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will return unto you, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zechariah 1:4
text: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets cried, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings; but they did not hearken nor attend unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 1:5
text: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

title: Zechariah 1:6
text: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? And they turned and said, Like as Jehovah of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

title: Zechariah 1:7
text: ¶Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah unto Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

title: Zechariah 1:8
text: I saw by night, and behold, a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle-trees that were in the low valley; and behind him were red, bay, and white horses.

title: Zechariah 1:9
text: And I said, My lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these are.

title: Zechariah 1:10
text: And the man that stood among the myrtle-trees answered and said, These are they whom Jehovah hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

title: Zechariah 1:11
text: And they answered the angel of Jehovah that stood among the myrtle-trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and behold, all the earth sitteth still and is at rest.

title: Zechariah 1:12
text: And the angel of Jehovah answered and said, Jehovah of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these seventy years?

title: Zechariah 1:13
text: And Jehovah answered the angel that talked with me good words, comforting words.

title: Zechariah 1:14
text: And the angel that talked with me said unto me, Cry, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy,

title: Zechariah 1:15
text: and I am wroth exceedingly with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little wroth, and they helped forward the affliction.

title: Zechariah 1:16
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith Jehovah of hosts, and the line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:17
text: Cry further, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: My cities shall yet overflow with prosperity, and Jehovah shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:18
text: ¶And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

title: Zechariah 1:19
text: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these? And he said to me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:20
text: And Jehovah shewed me four craftsmen.

title: Zechariah 1:21
text: And I said, What come these to do? And he spoke, saying, Those are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these are come to affright them, to cast out the horns of the nations, which lifted up the horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.

title: Zechariah 2:1
text: ¶And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

title: Zechariah 2:2
text: And I said, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

title: Zechariah 2:3
text: And behold, the angel that talked with me went forth; and another angel went forth to meet him,

title: Zechariah 2:4
text: and said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein;

title: Zechariah 2:5
text: and I, saith Jehovah, I will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

title: Zechariah 2:6
text: ¶Ho, ho! flee from the land of the north, saith Jehovah; for I have scattered you abroad as the four winds of the heavens, saith Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 2:7
text: Ho! escape, Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

title: Zechariah 2:8
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: After the glory, hath he sent me unto the nations that made you a spoil; for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

title: Zechariah 2:9
text: For behold, I will shake my hand upon them, and they shall become a spoil to those that served them: and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me.

title: Zechariah 2:10
text: ¶Sing aloud and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for behold, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 2:11
text: And many nations shall join themselves to Jehovah in that day, and shall be unto me for a people; and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

title: Zechariah 2:12
text: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah [as] his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 2:13
text: Let all flesh be silent before Jehovah; for he is risen up out of his holy habitation.

title: Zechariah 3:1
text: ¶And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the Angel of Jehovah, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

title: Zechariah 3:2
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Jehovah rebuke thee, O Satan! Yea, Jehovah that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee! Is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

title: Zechariah 3:3
text: And Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the Angel.

title: Zechariah 3:4
text: And he spoke and said unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from off him. And unto him he said, See, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I clothe thee with festival-robes.

title: Zechariah 3:5
text: And I said, Let them set a pure turban upon his head. And they set the pure turban upon his head, and clothed him with garments; and the Angel of Jehovah stood by.

title: Zechariah 3:6
text: And the Angel of Jehovah protested unto Joshua, saying,

title: Zechariah 3:7
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts; and I will give thee a place to walk among these that stand by.

title: Zechariah 3:8
text: ¶Hear now, Joshua the high priest, thou and thy fellows that sit before thee--for they are men of portent--for behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.

title: Zechariah 3:9
text: For behold, the stone that I have laid before Joshua--upon one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in one day.

title: Zechariah 3:10
text: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall ye invite every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig-tree.

title: Zechariah 4:1
text: ¶And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.

title: Zechariah 4:2
text: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I see, and behold, a lamp-stand all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and its seven lamps thereon, seven [lamps] and seven pipes to the lamps, which are upon the top thereof;

title: Zechariah 4:3
text: and two olive-trees beside it, one on the right of the bowl, and the other on the left of it.

title: Zechariah 4:4
text: And I answered and spoke to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

title: Zechariah 4:5
text: And the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

title: Zechariah 4:6
text: And he answered and spoke unto me, saying, This is the word of Jehovah unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zechariah 4:7
text: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel [thou dost become] a plain; and he shall bring forth the head-stone with shoutings: Grace, grace unto it!

title: Zechariah 4:8
