text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Zechariah 4:9
text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; and his hands shall finish it: and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto you.

title: Zechariah 4:10
text: For who hath despised the day of small things? Yea, they shall rejoice [even] those seven--and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel: these are the eyes of Jehovah, which run to and fro in the whole earth.

title: Zechariah 4:11
text: ¶And I answered and said unto him, What are these two olive-trees on the right of the lamp-stand and on its left?

title: Zechariah 4:12
text: And I answered the second time and said unto him, What are the two olive-branches which are beside the two golden tubes that empty the gold out of themselves?

title: Zechariah 4:13
text: And he spoke to me, saying, Knowest thou not what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

title: Zechariah 4:14
text: And he said, These are the two sons of oil, that stand before the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Zechariah 5:1
text: ¶And I lifted up mine eyes again, and saw, and behold, a flying roll.

title: Zechariah 5:2
text: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I see a flying roll: the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

title: Zechariah 5:3
text: And he said unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole land: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off according to it on this side; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off according to it on that side.

title: Zechariah 5:4
text: I will cause it to go forth, saith Jehovah of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name; and it shall lodge in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

title: Zechariah 5:5
text: ¶And the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.

title: Zechariah 5:6
text: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is the ephah that goeth forth. And he said, This is their resemblance in all the land.

title: Zechariah 5:7
text: And behold, there was lifted up a round plate of lead; and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

title: Zechariah 5:8
text: And he said, This is Wickedness: and he cast her into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

title: Zechariah 5:9
text: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of a stork; and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.

title: Zechariah 5:10
text: And I said to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these carry the ephah?

title: Zechariah 5:11
text: And he said unto me, To build it a house in the land of Shinar; and it shall be established, and set there upon its own base.

title: Zechariah 6:1
text: ¶And I lifted up mine eyes again, and saw, and behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

title: Zechariah 6:2
text: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

title: Zechariah 6:3
text: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled, strong horses.

title: Zechariah 6:4
text: And I spoke and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

title: Zechariah 6:5
text: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

title: Zechariah 6:6
text: That in which are the black horses goeth forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth towards the south country;

title: Zechariah 6:7
text: and the strong go forth, and seek to go that they may walk to and fro through the earth. And he said, Go, walk to and fro through the earth. And they walked to and fro through the earth.

title: Zechariah 6:8
text: And he cried unto me, and spoke unto me, saying, See, these that go forth towards the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

title: Zechariah 6:9
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Zechariah 6:10
text: Take [gifts] of them of the captivity, of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, and come thou the same day, and enter into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, whither they are come from Babylon;

title: Zechariah 6:11
text: yea, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set [them] upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

title: Zechariah 6:12
text: and speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, saying, Behold a man whose name is [the] Branch; and he shall grow up from his own place, and he shall build the temple of Jehovah:

title: Zechariah 6:13
text: even he shall build the temple of Jehovah; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne; and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

title: Zechariah 6:14
text: And the crowns shall be for Helem, and for Tobijah, and for Jedaiah, and for Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 6:15
text: And they that are far off shall come and build at the temple of Jehovah: and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto you. And [this] shall come to pass, if ye will diligently hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God.

title: Zechariah 7:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Jehovah came unto Zechariah on the fourth [day] of the ninth month, [even] in Chislev,

title: Zechariah 7:2
text: when Bethel had sent Sherezer and Regem-melech, and his men, to supplicate Jehovah,

title: Zechariah 7:3
text: [and] to speak unto the priests that were in the house of Jehovah of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done now so many years?

title: Zechariah 7:4
text: And the word of Jehovah of hosts came unto me, saying,

title: Zechariah 7:5
text: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh [month], even those seventy years, did ye really fast unto me, [even] unto me?

title: Zechariah 7:6
text: And when ye ate, and when ye drank, was it not you that were eating and drinking?

title: Zechariah 7:7
text: Are not these the words that Jehovah cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and at peace, and her cities round about her, when the south and the lowland were inhabited?

title: Zechariah 7:8
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto Zechariah, saying,

title: Zechariah 7:9
text: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew loving-kindness and mercies one to another,

title: Zechariah 7:10
text: and oppress not the widow and the fatherless, the stranger and the afflicted; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

title: Zechariah 7:11
text: But they refused to hearken, and turned a rebellious shoulder, and made their ears heavy, that they should not hear.

title: Zechariah 7:12
text: And they made their heart [as] an adamant, that they should not hear the law, and the words that Jehovah of hosts sent by his Spirit by the hand of the former prophets: therefore was there great wrath from Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zechariah 7:13
text: And it came to pass, like as he called, and they would not hear, so they called, and I would not hear, saith Jehovah of hosts;

title: Zechariah 7:14
text: and I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not, and the land was desolate after them, so that no one passed through nor returned; and they laid the pleasant land desolate.

title: Zechariah 8:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah of hosts came [unto me], saying,

title: Zechariah 8:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great fury.

title: Zechariah 8:3
text: Thus saith Jehovah: I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and Jerusalem shall be called, The city of truth; and the mountain of Jehovah of hosts, The holy mountain.

title: Zechariah 8:4
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: There shall yet old men and old women sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each one with his staff in his hand for multitude of days.

title: Zechariah 8:5
text: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

title: Zechariah 8:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If it be wonderful in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be wonderful in mine eyes? saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Zechariah 8:7
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country;

title: Zechariah 8:8
text: and I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

title: Zechariah 8:9
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, that were in the day that the foundation of the house of Jehovah of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

title: Zechariah 8:10
text: For before those days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; and there was no peace for him that went out or that came in, because of the distress: for I let loose all men, every one against his neighbour.

title: Zechariah 8:11
text: But now I will not be unto the remnant of this people as in the former days, saith Jehovah of hosts;

title: Zechariah 8:12
text: for the seed shall be prosperous, the vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its produce, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these [things].

title: Zechariah 8:13
text: And it shall come to pass, like as ye were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear ye not, let your hands be strong.

title: Zechariah 8:14
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Like as I thought to do you evil when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I repented not;

title: Zechariah 8:15
text: so again have I thought in these days to do good unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

title: Zechariah 8:16
text: These are the things that ye shall do: Speak truth every one with his neighbour; execute truth and the judgment of peace in your gates;

title: Zechariah 8:17
text: and let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are [things] that I hate, saith Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 8:18
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah of hosts came unto me, saying,

title: Zechariah 8:19
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The fast of the fourth [month] and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful gatherings. Love ye then truth and peace.

title: Zechariah 8:20
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Yet again shall there come peoples, and the inhabitants of many cities;

title: Zechariah 8:21
text: and the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to supplicate Jehovah, and to seek Jehovah of hosts: I will go also.

title: Zechariah 8:22
text: And many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek Jehovah of hosts in Jerusalem, and to supplicate Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 8:23
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: In those days shall ten men take hold, out of all languages of the nations, shall even take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you; for we have heard [that] God is with you.

title: Zechariah 9:1
text: ¶The burden of the word of Jehovah, in the land of Hadrach, and [on] Damascus shall it rest; (for Jehovah hath an eye upon men, and upon all the tribes of Israel;)

title: Zechariah 9:2
text: and also [on] Hamath [which] bordereth thereon; on Tyre and Zidon, though she be very wise.

title: Zechariah 9:3
text: And Tyre hath built herself a stronghold, and hath heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

title: Zechariah 9:4
text: Behold, the Lord will take possession of her, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

title: Zechariah 9:5
text: Ashkelon shall see [it], and fear; Gazah also, and she shall be greatly pained; Ekron also, for her expectation shall be put to shame: and the king shall perish from Gazah, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

title: Zechariah 9:6
text: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines;

title: Zechariah 9:7
text: and I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; but he that remaineth, he also shall belong to our God, and shall be as a leader in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

title: Zechariah 9:8
text: And I will encamp about my house because of the army, because of those that pass by and that return; and the exactor shall not pass through them any more: for now have I seen [it] with mine eyes.

title: Zechariah 9:9
text: ¶Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion; shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, thy King cometh to thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly and riding upon an ass, even upon a colt the foal of an ass.

title: Zechariah 9:10
text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle-bow shall be cut off. And he shall speak peace unto the nations; and his dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

title: Zechariah 9:11
text: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant, I will send forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

title: Zechariah 9:12
text: ¶Turn again to the stronghold, prisoners of hope! even to-day do I declare I will render double unto thee.

title: Zechariah 9:13
text: For I have bent Judah for me, I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I will raise up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and make thee like the sword of a mighty man.

title: Zechariah 9:14
text: And Jehovah shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning; and the Lord Jehovah will blow the trumpet, and will march with whirlwinds of the south.

title: Zechariah 9:15
text: Jehovah of hosts will defend them; and they shall devour, and shall tread down the sling-stones; and they shall drink, [and] make a noise as from wine; and they shall be filled like a bowl, like the corners of the altar.

title: Zechariah 9:16
text: And Jehovah their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people; for [they shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted up upon his land.

title: Zechariah 9:17
text: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Corn shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the maidens.

title: Zechariah 10:1
text: ¶Ask of Jehovah rain in the time of the latter rain; Jehovah will make lightnings, and he will give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

title: Zechariah 10:2
text: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams: they comfort in vain. Therefore they have gone away as a flock, they are in distress, because there is no shepherd.

title: Zechariah 10:3
text: Mine anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the he-goats; for Jehovah of hosts visiteth his flock, the house of Judah, and maketh them as his majestic horse in the battle.

title: Zechariah 10:4
text: From him shall come forth the corner-stone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every exactor together.

title: Zechariah 10:5
text: ¶And they shall be as mighty men, treading down the mire of the streets in the battle; and they shall fight, for Jehovah is with them, and the riders on horses shall be put to shame.

title: Zechariah 10:6
text: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back again; for I will have mercy upon them; and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Jehovah their God, and I will answer them.

title: Zechariah 10:7
text: And [they of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their hearts shall rejoice as through wine; and their children shall see [it], and rejoice; their heart shall be joyful in Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 10:8
text: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall multiply as they used to multiply.

title: Zechariah 10:9
text: And I will sow them among the peoples, and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children and return.

title: Zechariah 10:10
text: And I will bring them again out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and [place] shall not be found for them.

title: Zechariah 10:11
text: And he shall pass through the sea of affliction, and shall smite the billows in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile shall dry up; and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

title: Zechariah 10:12
text: And I will strengthen them in Jehovah; and they shall walk in his name, saith Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 11:1
text: ¶Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

title: Zechariah 11:2
text: Howl, cypress, for the cedar is fallen; because the noble ones are spoiled. Howl, ye oaks of Bashan; for the strong forest is come down.

title: Zechariah 11:3
text: A voice of howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

title: Zechariah 11:4
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah my God: Feed the flock of slaughter,

title: Zechariah 11:5
text: whose possessors slay them without being held guilty; and they that sell them say, Blessed be Jehovah! for I am become rich; and their own shepherds pity them not.

title: Zechariah 11:6
text: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah, and behold, I will deliver men, every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king; and they shall smite the land, and I will not deliver out of their hand.

title: Zechariah 11:7
text: So I fed the flock of slaughter, truly the poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

title: Zechariah 11:8
text: And I destroyed three shepherds in one month; and my soul was vexed with them, and their soul also loathed me.

title: Zechariah 11:9
text: And I said, I will not feed you: that which dieth, let it die; and that which perisheth let it perish; and let them which are left eat every one the flesh of another.

title: Zechariah 11:10
text: And I took my staff, Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the peoples.

title: Zechariah 11:11
text: And it was broken in that day; and so the poor of the flock that gave heed to me knew that it was the word of Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 11:12
text: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give [me] my hire; and if not, forbear. And they weighed for my hire thirty silver-pieces.

title: Zechariah 11:13
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prized at by them. And I took the thirty silver-pieces, and cast them to the potter in the house of Jehovah.

title: Zechariah 11:14
text: And I cut asunder mine other staff, Bands, to break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

title: Zechariah 11:15
text: ¶And Jehovah said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

title: Zechariah 11:16
text: For behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who shall not visit those that are about to perish, neither shall seek that which is strayed away, nor heal that which is wounded, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their hoofs in pieces.

title: Zechariah 11:17
text: Woe to the worthless shepherd that leaveth the flock! The sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye; his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye utterly darkened.

title: Zechariah 12:1
text: ¶The burden of the word of Jehovah concerning Israel. [Thus] saith Jehovah, who stretcheth out the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him:

title: Zechariah 12:2
text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of bewilderment unto all the peoples round about, and also against Judah shall it be in the siege against Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:3
text: And it shall come to pass in that day [that] I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone unto all peoples: all that burden themselves with it shall certainly be wounded, and all the nations of the earth shall be assembled together against it.

title: Zechariah 12:4
text: In that day, saith Jehovah, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness; but I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the peoples with blindness.

title: Zechariah 12:5
text: And the leaders of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength through Jehovah of hosts their God.

title: Zechariah 12:6
text: In that day will I make the leaders of Judah like a hearth of fire among wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the peoples round about, on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem shall dwell again in her own place, in Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:7
text: And Jehovah shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem be not magnified over Judah.

title: Zechariah 12:8
text: In that day will Jehovah defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that stumbleth among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David as God, as the Angel of Jehovah before them.

title: Zechariah 12:9
text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:10
text: And I will pour upon the house of David and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplications; and they shall look on me whom they pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for an only [son], and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for [his] firstborn.

title: Zechariah 12:11
text: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

title: Zechariah 12:12
text: And the land shall mourn, every family apart: the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

title: Zechariah 12:13
text: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

title: Zechariah 12:14
text: all the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

title: Zechariah 13:1
text: ¶In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

title: Zechariah 13:2
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, [that] I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered; and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

title: Zechariah 13:3
text: And it shall come to pass, if any shall yet prophesy, that his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of Jehovah; and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

title: Zechariah 13:4
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he prophesieth; neither shall they wear a hairy mantle to deceive.

title: Zechariah 13:5
text: And he shall say, I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for man acquired me [as bondman] from my youth.

title: Zechariah 13:6
text: And one shall say unto him, What are those wounds in thy hands? And he will say, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

title: Zechariah 13:7
text: ¶Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, even against the man [that is] my fellow, saith Jehovah of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered, and I will turn my hand upon the little ones.

title: Zechariah 13:8
text: And it shall come to pass in all the land, saith Jehovah, two parts therein shall be cut off [and] die; but the third shall be left therein.

title: Zechariah 13:9
text: And I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried. They shall call on my name, and I will answer them: I will say, It is my people; and they shall say, Jehovah is my God.

title: Zechariah 14:1
text: ¶Behold, the day cometh for Jehovah, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

title: Zechariah 14:2
text: And I will assemble all the nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity; and the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

title: Zechariah 14:3
text: And Jehovah will go forth and fight with those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

title: Zechariah 14:4
text: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem toward the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, --a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

title: Zechariah 14:5
text: And ye shall flee [by] the valley of my mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: ye shall even flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. And Jehovah my God shall come, [and] all the holy ones with thee.

title: Zechariah 14:6
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] there shall not be light; the shining shall be obscured.

title: Zechariah 14:7
text: And it shall be one day which is known to Jehovah, not day, and not night; and it shall come to pass, at eventide it shall be light.

title: Zechariah 14:8
text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day [that] living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

title: Zechariah 14:9
text: And Jehovah shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Jehovah, and his name one.

title: Zechariah 14:10
text: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem shall be turned as the Arabah; and [Jerusalem] shall be lifted up, and shall dwell in her own place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner-gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.

title: Zechariah 14:11
text: And [men] shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; and Jerusalem shall dwell safely.

title: Zechariah 14:12
text: And this shall be the plague wherewith Jehovah will smite all the peoples that have warred against Jerusalem: their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

title: Zechariah 14:13
text: And it shall come to pass in that day [that] a great panic from Jehovah shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

title: Zechariah 14:14
text: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about shall be gathered together--gold, and silver, and garments, in great abundance.

title: Zechariah 14:15
text: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in those camps, as this plague.

title: Zechariah 14:16
text: ¶And it shall come to pass, that all that are left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, Jehovah of hosts, and to celebrate the feast of tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:17
text: And it shall be, that whoso goeth not up of the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, Jehovah of hosts, upon them shall be no rain.

title: Zechariah 14:18
text: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, neither [shall it be] upon them; [there] shall be the plague, wherewith Jehovah will smite the nations that go not up to celebrate the feast of tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:19
text: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that go not up to celebrate the feast of tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:20
text: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO JEHOVAH; and the pots in Jehovah's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

title: Zechariah 14:21
text: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto Jehovah of hosts; and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein. And in that day there shall be no more a Canaanite in the house of Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:1
text: ¶The burden of the word of Jehovah to Israel by Malachi.

title: Malachi 1:2
text: I have loved you, saith Jehovah; but ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith Jehovah, and I loved Jacob,

title: Malachi 1:3
text: and I hated Esau; and made his mountains a desolation, and [gave] his inheritance to the jackals of the wilderness.

title: Malachi 1:4
text: If Edom say, We are broken down, but we will build again the ruined places, --thus saith Jehovah of hosts: They shall build, but I will throw down; and [men] shall call them the territory of wickedness, and the people against whom Jehovah hath indignation for ever.

title: Malachi 1:5
text: And your eyes shall see [it], and ye shall say, Jehovah is magnified beyond the border of Israel.

title: Malachi 1:6
text: ¶A son honoureth [his] father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith Jehovah of hosts unto you, priests, that despise my name. But ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

title: Malachi 1:7
text: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of Jehovah is contemptible.

title: Malachi 1:8
text: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? And if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? Present it now unto thy governor: will he be pleased with thee? or will he accept thy person? saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:9
text: And now, I pray you, beseech *God that he will be gracious unto us. This hath been of your hand: will he accept any of your persons? saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:10
text: Who is there among you that would even shut the doors? and ye would not kindle [fire] on mine altar for nothing. I have no delight in you, saith Jehovah of hosts, neither will I accept an oblation at your hand.

title: Malachi 1:11
text: For from the rising of the sun even unto its setting my name shall be great among the nations; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure oblation: for my name shall be great among the nations, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:12
text: But ye profane it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted; and the fruit thereof, his food, is contemptible.

title: Malachi 1:13
text: And ye say, Behold, what a weariness! And ye have puffed at it, saith Jehovah of hosts, and ye bring [that which was] torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye bring the oblation: should I accept this of your hand? saith Jehovah.

title: Malachi 1:14
text: Yea, cursed be the deceiver, who hath in his flock a male, and voweth and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing; for I am a great King, saith Jehovah of hosts, and my name is terrible among the nations.

title: Malachi 2:1
text: ¶And now, ye priests, this commandment is for you.

title: Malachi 2:2
text: If ye do not hear, and if ye do not lay [it] to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith Jehovah of hosts, I will even send the curse among you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have already cursed them, because ye do not lay [it] to heart.

title: Malachi 2:3
text: Behold, I will rebuke your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, the dung of your feasts; and they shall take you away with it.

title: Malachi 2:4
text: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:5
text: My covenant with him was of life and peace, and I gave them to him that he might fear; and he feared me, and trembled before my name.

title: Malachi 2:6
text: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.

title: Malachi 2:7
text: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and at his mouth they seek the law; for he is the messenger of Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:8
text: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:9
text: And I also have made you contemptible and base before all the people, because ye have not kept my ways, but have respect of persons in [administering] the law.

title: Malachi 2:10
text: ¶Have we not all one father? Hath not one *God created us? Why do we deal unfaithfully every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

title: Malachi 2:11
text: Judah hath dealt unfaithfully, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the sanctuary of Jehovah which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange *god.

title: Malachi 2:12
text: Jehovah will cut off from the tents of Jacob the man that doeth this, him that calleth and him that answereth; and him that offereth an oblation unto Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:13
text: And further ye do this: ye cover the altar of Jehovah with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, insomuch that he regardeth not the oblation any more, nor receiveth [it] with satisfaction at your hand.

title: Malachi 2:14
text: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because Jehovah hath been a witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt unfaithfully: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

title: Malachi 2:15
text: And did not one make [them]? and the remnant of the Spirit was his. And wherefore the one? He sought a seed of God. Take heed then to your spirit, and let none deal unfaithfully against the wife of his youth,

title: Malachi 2:16
text: (for I hate putting away, saith Jehovah the God of Israel;) and he covereth with violence his garment, saith Jehovah of hosts: take heed then to your spirit, that ye deal not unfaithfully.

title: Malachi 2:17
text: Ye have wearied Jehovah with your words, and ye say, Wherein have we wearied [him]? In that ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of Jehovah, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?

title: Malachi 3:1
text: ¶Behold, I send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me; and the Lord whom ye seek will suddenly come to his temple, and the Angel of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he cometh, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:2
text: But who shall endure the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? For he will be like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' lye.

title: Malachi 3:3
text: And he shall sit [as] a refiner and purifier of silver; and he will purify the children of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver; and they shall offer unto Jehovah an oblation in righteousness.

title: Malachi 3:4
text: Then shall the oblation of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto Jehovah, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

title: Malachi 3:5
text: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the false swearers, and against those that oppress the hired servant in [his] wages, the widow and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger [from his right], and fear not me, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:6
text: For I Jehovah change not, and ye, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

title: Malachi 3:7
text: ¶Since the days of your fathers have ye departed from my statutes, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith Jehovah of hosts. But ye say, Wherein shall we return?

title: Malachi 3:8
text: Will a man rob God? But ye rob me. And ye say, Wherein do we rob thee? [In] tithes and heave-offerings.

title: Malachi 3:9
text: Ye are cursed with a curse; and me ye rob, [even] this whole nation.

title: Malachi 3:10
text: Bring the whole tithe into the treasure-house, that there may be food in my house, and prove me now herewith, saith Jehovah of hosts, if I open not to you the windows of the heavens, and pour you out a blessing, till there be no place for it.

title: Malachi 3:11
text: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before the time in the field, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:12
text: And all nations shall call you blessed; for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:13
text: ¶Your words have been stout against me, saith Jehovah; but ye say, What have we been speaking against thee?

title: Malachi 3:14
text: Ye say, It is vain to serve God; and what profit is it that we keep his charge, and that we walk mournfully before Jehovah of hosts?

title: Malachi 3:15
text: And now we hold the proud for happy; yea, they that work wickedness are built up; yea, they tempt God, and they escape.

title: Malachi 3:16
text: Then they that feared Jehovah spoke often one to another; and Jehovah observed [it], and heard, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Jehovah, and that thought upon his name.

title: Malachi 3:17
text: And they shall be unto me a peculiar treasure, saith Jehovah of hosts, in the day that I prepare; and I will spare them as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

title: Malachi 3:18
text: And ye shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

title: Malachi 4:1
text: ¶For behold, the day cometh, burning as a furnace; and all the proud and all that work wickedness shall be stubble; and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Jehovah of hosts, so that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

title: Malachi 4:2
text: And unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth and leap like fatted calves.

title: Malachi 4:3
text: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I prepare, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Malachi 4:4
text: ¶Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, the statutes and ordinances.

title: Malachi 4:5
text: Behold, I send unto you Elijah the prophet, before the coming of the great and terrible day of Jehovah.

title: Malachi 4:6
text: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

title: Matthew 1:1
text: ¶Book of the generation of Jesus Christ, Son of David, Son of Abraham.

title: Matthew 1:2
text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Juda and his brethren;

title: Matthew 1:3
text: and Juda begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom, and Esrom begat Aram,

title: Matthew 1:4
text: and Aram begat Aminadab, and Aminadab begat Naasson, and Naasson begat Salmon,

title: Matthew 1:5
text: and Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse,

title: Matthew 1:6
text: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon, of her [that had been the wife] of Urias;

title: Matthew 1:7
text: and Solomon begat Roboam, and Roboam begat Abia, and Abia begat Asa,

title: Matthew 1:8
text: and Asa begat Josaphat, and Josaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Ozias,

title: Matthew 1:9
text: and Ozias begat Joatham, and Joatham begat Achaz, and Achaz begat Ezekias,

title: Matthew 1:10
text: and Ezekias begat Manasses, and Manasses begat Amon, and Amon begat Josias,

title: Matthew 1:11
text: and Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away of Babylon.

title: Matthew 1:12
text: And after the carrying away of Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel, and Salathiel begat Zorobabel,

title: Matthew 1:13
text: and Zorobabel begat Abiud, and Abiud begat Eliakim, and Eliakim begat Azor,

title: Matthew 1:14
text: and Azor begat Sadoc, and Sadoc begat Achim, and Achim begat Eliud,

title: Matthew 1:15
text: and Eliud begat Eliazar, and Eliazar begat Matthan, and Matthan begat Jacob,

title: Matthew 1:16
text: and Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

title: Matthew 1:17
text: All the generations, therefore, from Abraham to David [were] fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away of Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the carrying away of Babylon unto the Christ, fourteen generations.

title: Matthew 1:18
text: ¶Now the birth of Jesus Christ was thus: His mother, Mary, that is, having been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together, she was found to be with child of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Matthew 1:19
text: But Joseph, her husband, being [a] righteous [man], and unwilling to expose her publicly, purposed to have put her away secretly;

title: Matthew 1:20
text: but while he pondered on these things, behold, an angel of [the] Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, fear not to take to [thee] Mary, thy wife, for that which is begotten in her is of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Matthew 1:21
text: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus, for *he* shall save his people from their sins.

title: Matthew 1:22
text: Now all this came to pass that that might be fulfilled which was spoken by [the] Lord, through the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 1:23
text: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which is, being interpreted, 'God with us.'

title: Matthew 1:24
text: But Joseph, having awoke up from his sleep, did as the angel of [the] Lord had enjoined him, and took to [him] his wife,

title: Matthew 1:25
text: and knew her not until she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.

title: Matthew 2:1
text: ¶Now Jesus having been born in Bethlehem of Judaea, in the days of Herod the king, behold magi from the east arrived at Jerusalem, saying,

title: Matthew 2:2
text: Where is the king of the Jews that has been born? for we have seen his star in the east, and have come to do him homage.

title: Matthew 2:3
text: But Herod the king having heard [of it], was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him;

title: Matthew 2:4
text: and, assembling all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ should be born.

title: Matthew 2:5
text: And they said to him, In Bethlehem of Judaea; for thus it is written through the prophet:

title: Matthew 2:6
text: And *thou* Bethlehem, land of Juda, art in no wise the least among the governors of Juda; for out of thee shall go forth a leader who shall shepherd my people Israel.

title: Matthew 2:7
text: Then Herod, having secretly called the magi, inquired of them accurately the time of the star that was appearing;

title: Matthew 2:8
text: and having sent them to Bethlehem, said, Go, search out accurately concerning the child, and when ye shall have found [him] bring me back word, so that *I* also may come and do him homage.

title: Matthew 2:9
text: ¶And they having heard the king went their way; and lo, the star, which they had seen in the east, went before them until it came and stood over the place where the little child was.

title: Matthew 2:10
text: And when they saw the star they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

title: Matthew 2:11
text: And having come into the house they saw the little child with Mary his mother, and falling down did him homage. And having opened their treasures, they offered to him gifts, gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

title: Matthew 2:12
text: And being divinely instructed in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

title: Matthew 2:13
text: ¶Now, they having departed, behold, an angel of [the] Lord appears in a dream to Joseph, saying, Arise, take to [thee] the little child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be there until I shall tell thee; for Herod will seek the little child to destroy it.

title: Matthew 2:14
text: And, having arisen, he took to [him] the little child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt.

title: Matthew 2:15
text: And he was there until the death of Herod, that that might be fulfilled which was spoken by [the] Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

title: Matthew 2:16
text: ¶Then Herod, seeing that he had been mocked by the magi, was greatly enraged; and sent and slew all the boys which [were] in Bethlehem, and in all its borders, from two years and under, according to the time which he had accurately inquired from the magi.

title: Matthew 2:17
text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremias the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 2:18
text: A voice has been heard in Rama, weeping, and great lamentation: Rachel weeping [for] her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

title: Matthew 2:19
text: ¶But Herod having died, behold, an angel of [the] Lord appears in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

title: Matthew 2:20
text: Arise, take to [thee] the little child and its mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they who sought the life of the little child are dead.

title: Matthew 2:21
text: And he arose and took to [him] the little child and its mother, and came into the land of Israel;

title: Matthew 2:22
text: but having heard that 'Archelaus reigns over Judaea, instead of Herod his father,' he was afraid to go there; and having been divinely instructed in a dream, he went away into the parts of Galilee,

title: Matthew 2:23
text: and came and dwelt in a town called Nazareth; so that that should be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets, He shall be called a Nazaraene.

title: Matthew 3:1
text: ¶Now in those days comes John the baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

title: Matthew 3:2
text: and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn nigh.

title: Matthew 3:3
text: For this is he who has been spoken of through Esaias the prophet, saying, Voice of him that crieth in the wilderness: prepare ye the way of [the] Lord, make straight his paths.

title: Matthew 3:4
text: And John himself had his garment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins, and his nourishment was locusts and wild honey.

title: Matthew 3:5
text: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the country round the Jordan,

title: Matthew 3:6
text: and were baptised by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

title: Matthew 3:7
text: ¶But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who has forewarned you to flee from the coming wrath?

title: Matthew 3:8
text: Produce therefore fruit worthy of repentance.

title: Matthew 3:9
text: And do not think to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for [our] father; for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham.

title: Matthew 3:10
text: And already the axe is applied to the root of the trees; every tree therefore not producing good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

title: Matthew 3:11
text: *I* indeed baptise you with water to repentance, but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not fit to bear; *he* shall baptise you with [the] Holy Spirit and fire;

title: Matthew 3:12
text: whose winnowing fan [is] in his hand, and he shall thoroughly purge his threshing-floor, and shall gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

title: Matthew 3:13
text: ¶Then comes Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptised of him;

title: Matthew 3:14
text: but John urgently forbad him, saying, *I* have need to be baptised of thee; and comest *thou* to me?

title: Matthew 3:15
text: But Jesus answering said to him, Suffer [it] now; for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffers him.

title: Matthew 3:16
text: And Jesus, having been baptised, went up straightway from the water, and lo, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him:

title: Matthew 3:17
text: and behold, a voice out of the heavens saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I have found my delight.

title: Matthew 4:1
text: ¶Then Jesus was carried up into the wilderness by the Spirit to be tempted of the devil:

title: Matthew 4:2
text: and having fasted forty days and forty nights, afterwards he hungered.

title: Matthew 4:3
text: And the tempter coming up to him said, If thou be Son of God, speak, that these stones may become loaves of bread.

title: Matthew 4:4
text: But he answering said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word which goes out through God's mouth.

title: Matthew 4:5
text: Then the devil takes him to the holy city, and sets him upon the edge of the temple,

title: Matthew 4:6
text: and says to him, If thou be Son of God cast thyself down; for it is written, He shall give charge to his angels concerning thee, and on [their] hands shall they bear thee, lest in anywise thou strike thy foot against a stone.

title: Matthew 4:7
text: Jesus said to him, It is again written, Thou shalt not tempt [the] Lord thy God.

title: Matthew 4:8
text: Again the devil takes him to a very high mountain, and shews him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory,

title: Matthew 4:9
text: and says to him, All these things will I give thee if, falling down, thou wilt do me homage.

title: Matthew 4:10
text: Then says Jesus to him, Get thee away, Satan, for it is written, Thou shalt do homage to [the] Lord thy God, and him alone shalt thou serve.

title: Matthew 4:11
text: Then the devil leaves him, and behold, angels came and ministered to him.

title: Matthew 4:12
text: ¶But having heard that John was delivered up, he departed into Galilee:

title: Matthew 4:13
text: and having left Nazareth, he went and dwelt at Capernaum, which is on the sea-side in the borders of Zabulon and Nepthalim,
